appearance_body_floor.en: a whole number of pixels from {min} up; an empty box takes the size the page is drawn at
appearance_body_floor.zh: {min} 起的整数像素；留空即采用页面本来的字号

appearance_local_denied.en: the browser did not hand over the list; write the stack instead
appearance_local_denied.zh: 浏览器没有交出字体列表，请改为手写字体栈

appearance_local_for.en: {face}, from the faces this computer has
appearance_local_for.zh: {face}：从这台电脑装好的字体里选

appearance_local_none.en: this browser does not offer its installed faces; write the stack instead
appearance_local_none.zh: 这个浏览器不提供已装字体列表，请改为手写字体栈

appearance_reading_note.en: the face messages, documents and reports are set in; code, paths and commands stay in the mono face
appearance_reading_note.zh: 消息、文档与报告的正文用哪个字体；代码、路径与命令仍是等宽字体

appearance_reading_sample.en: A settled reply reads like a page of a book. 一段写完的回复，读起来像书里的一页。
appearance_reading_sample.zh: 一段写完的回复，读起来像书里的一页。A settled reply reads like a page of a book.

appearance_sample.en: The city keeps 1 ledger, and reads both 中文 and English from it.
appearance_sample.zh: 这座城市只有 1 本 ledger，中文与 English 都从那里读出来。

appearance_stack_help.en: family names separated by commas; the first one that is installed is used
appearance_stack_help.zh: 用逗号分隔的字体名，取其中第一个装了的

appearance_stack_refused.en: only letters, digits, spaces, commas and quotes belong in a stack
appearance_stack_refused.zh: 字体栈里只能有字母、数字、空格、逗号和引号

ask_late.en: the page keeps asking; if no answer ever comes back, reconnect from the notice
ask_late.zh: 页面会继续追问；若始终等不到回答，就从那条通知重连一次

bin_nothing.en: the recycle bin is empty: a file a run discards lands here, with the way to bring it back
bin_nothing.zh: 回收站是空的：run 丢掉的文件会落在这里，并写明怎样找回

bld_pursuit_finished.en: finished: nothing is ready and nobody is working
bld_pursuit_finished.zh: 已完成：没有就绪的活，也没有 run 在做

bld_pursuit_waiting.zh: 在等 {runs} 个还没结束的 run

bld_room_name.en: name a room to talk in
bld_room_name.zh: 给要说话的房间起个名字

city_drawing.en: the city, one block per building

city_layer_note.en: what every run in this city starts with unless its building or session says otherwise; written to CONFIG.toml
city_layer_note.zh: 城市里每个 run 开始时的默认，楼或会话另有设定时以它们为准；写进 CONFIG.toml

city_keep_warm.zh: 保持 prompt 缓存不过期

city_tower_line.zh: {runs} 次 run，{active} 在跑 · 完成 {percent}%

commits_all.en: that is every commit this building made
commits_all.zh: 这栋楼的提交都在这里了

commits_empty.en: no commits yet: a run's work lands here when it commits in this building
commits_empty.zh: 还没有提交：派活在这栋楼里提交后，会出现在这里

commits_more.en: older commits arrive as you scroll
commits_more.zh: 向下滚动，更早的提交随之载入

cost_empty.en: no run has spent anything yet
cost_empty.zh: 还没有哪次派活花掉钱

cost_unpriced.en: {calls} model calls came back with no price; they used {tokens} tokens
cost_unpriced.zh: {calls} 次模型调用没有报价，共用了 {tokens} 个 token

context_second_note.en: where in the window the line about a handoff is said
context_second_note.zh: 窗口用到几成时，提醒该写交接了

context_second_range.en: a whole percent of the window from {min} to {max}; an empty box is the city's default
context_second_range.zh: 窗口的整数百分比，{min} 到 {max}；留空即用城市的默认值

desktop_missing.en: This building has no desktop allowlist yet, so no run in it may touch a window. Write the windows it may touch in the box above and save: that creates {path}.
desktop_missing.zh: 这栋楼还没有桌面白名单，所以楼里的 run 碰不了任何窗口。在上面的框里写下它能碰的窗口，保存后就会建出 {path}。

dir_earlier_runs.en: earlier runs, not on this page · {n}

dir_governance_what.en: the rules and the configuration this building runs under
dir_governance_what.zh: 这栋楼依照的规则与配置

dir_room_empty.en: no run has worked in this room yet
dir_room_empty.zh: 还没有 run 在这个房间里干过活

effort_note_high.en: deeper reasoning at a higher price per answer, which is what most planning wants.
effort_note_high.zh: 推理更深、单次回答更贵，多数规划工作要的就是这一档。

effort_note_low.en: a short look before answering, for work whose steps are already known.
effort_note_low.zh: 答前略作检视，适合步骤已经定下来的活。

effort_note_max.en: the most this provider will spend on one answer: slowest, and dearest.
effort_note_max.zh: 这家供应方肯为一次回答花的上限：最慢，也最贵。

effort_note_minimal.en: almost no reasoning, for the quickest answer.
effort_note_minimal.zh: 几乎不推理，换来最快的回答。

effort_note_medium.en: the balance between what an answer costs and how far it reasons.
effort_note_medium.zh: 在回答的开销与推理的深度之间取平衡。

effort_note_none.en: thinking off: the model answers from the prompt without reasoning first.
effort_note_none.zh: 关掉思考：模型不先推理，直接依提示作答。

effort_note_unstated.en: nobody has chosen: the request uses high where this model offers it, otherwise the level the provider states as its default, and leaves the field out only when the provider states no default.
effort_note_unstated.zh: 还没有人选过：这个模型提供 high 就用 high，否则用供应方声明的默认档；供应方什么都没声明时，请求才不写这个字段。

effort_note_xhigh.en: longer reasoning, for work that has to be right the first time.
effort_note_xhigh.zh: 更长的推理，留给一次就要做对的活。

enrol_city_said_nothing.en: the city did not say why
enrol_city_said_nothing.zh: 这座城市没有说明理由

enrol_unreachable.en: this browser could not reach the city
enrol_unreachable.zh: 这个浏览器联系不上这座城市

refrain_save_nothing.en: nothing changed since the city's version
refrain_save_nothing.zh: 与城市里的版本相比没有改动

refrain_save_wait.en: the save in flight has no receipt yet
refrain_save_wait.zh: 上一次保存还没有回执

refrain_receipt_pending_why.en: the link dropped after the save left; it is sent again when the link is back
refrain_receipt_pending_why.zh: 保存发出后链路断了；链路恢复时会再发一次核对

refrain_gathering.en: read only until the whole text arrives: {through} of {total}

refrain_too_large.en: {total} is more than RefRain edits; the first {through} is shown read only
refrain_too_large.zh: {total} 超过 RefRain 能编辑的大小；只读显示前 {through}

refrain_recorded.en: version {version} is not the file's current one; read only
refrain_recorded.zh: 版本 {version} 不是这份文件此刻的版本；只读

refrain_lost.en: the city can no longer read version {version}

refrain_unreadable.en: the city cannot read this file: {reason}

refrain_conflict.en: the file is version {version} in the city now; your draft is kept
refrain_conflict.zh: 城市里的这份文件已经是版本 {version}；草稿留着

refrain_conflict_unknown.en: the city refused the save because the file moved; your draft is kept
refrain_conflict_unknown.zh: 文件已经变了，城市拒绝了这次保存；草稿留着

refrain_discard_detail.en: the editor shows the city's version and the unsaved changes are gone
refrain_discard_detail.zh: 编辑器改显城市里的版本，未保存的改动不再保留

refrain_draft_lost.en: a draft kept for version {version} cannot be restored: the city can no longer read that version
refrain_draft_lost.zh: 为版本 {version} 留的草稿恢复不了：城市已读不到那一版

refrain_preview_draft.en: the preview is version {version}; unsaved changes are not in it
refrain_preview_draft.zh: 预览的是版本 {version}；未保存的改动不在其中

refrain_preview_unsupported.en: this version does not read as Markdown ({encoding})
refrain_preview_unsupported.zh: 这一版不按 Markdown 读（{encoding}）

refrain_preview_empty.en: this version has nothing to preview
refrain_preview_empty.zh: 这一版没有可预览的内容

refrain_versions_one.en: the city knows one version of this file
refrain_versions_one.zh: 城市只知道这份文件的一个版本

refrain_version_on_disk.en: on disk now, written outside the page
refrain_version_on_disk.zh: 盘上此刻的一版，页面之外写下

refrain_versions_asking.en: asking the city for this file's versions…
refrain_versions_asking.zh: 正在问城市这份文件的各版…

refrain_version_lost.en: The city can no longer read one of these versions.
refrain_version_lost.zh: 城市读不出其中一版了。

refrain_compared_source.en: the source text, line by line

refrain_export_asking.en: the city is writing the export
refrain_export_asking.zh: 城市正在写导出的文件

refrain_export_refused.en: The city could not export this version.

refrain_cm_replaced_line.zh: 替换了第 $ 行的匹配

format_html_settings.en: scripts off · outside resources not read · links do not open
format_html_settings.zh: 脚本关闭 · 不读外部资源 · 链接不打开

format_pdf_settings.en: Adobe CMaps · fonts the file leaves out drawn with the device's own faces
format_pdf_settings.zh: Adobe CMap · 文件没带的字体用设备自带的字体画

format_docx_settings.en: approximate layout · tracked changes shown as their result · comments not shown
format_docx_settings.zh: 近似版式 · 修订按接受后的结果显示 · 不显示批注

format_locked.en: This PDF is protected by a password. The page does not open it; the file itself is unchanged.
format_locked.zh: 这份 PDF 有密码保护，页面不打开它；文件本身不动。

format_broken.en: This {format} could not be read ({reason}). The file itself is unchanged.
format_broken.zh: 读不出这份 {format}（{reason}）。文件本身不动。

format_zip_shape.en: it is not a ZIP archive this page reads
format_zip_shape.zh: 它不是本页读得懂的 ZIP 包

format_no_text.en: pages with no text layer are not compared and not read (a scan or drawn letters; no OCR is done): {pages}
format_no_text.zh: 没有文字层的页不比较也不朗读（扫描件或画出的字；不做 OCR）：{pages}

format_docx_revisions.en: {n} tracked changes, shown as their result

format_compare_pdf.en: compared: the text of each page in reading order; layout, pictures and fonts are not compared
format_compare_pdf.zh: 比较的是每页按阅读顺序的文字；版式、图片与字体不比较

format_compare_docx.en: compared: the body's paragraphs as their tracked changes leave them; headers, footers, comments and objects are not compared
format_compare_docx.zh: 比较的是正文段落按修订接受后的文字；页眉、页脚、批注与对象不比较

format_compare_broken.en: One of the two versions could not be read, so they are not compared.
format_compare_broken.zh: 两版里有一版读不出，所以不比较。

format_compare_same.en: the two versions read the same text

format_too_large.en: This {format} is {kib}, more than the {most} the page draws. The file itself is unchanged.
format_too_large.zh: 这份 {format} 有 {kib}，超过页面画的 {most}。文件本身不动。

format_lost.en: The city no longer holds this version, so it is not drawn. The file itself is unchanged.
format_lost.zh: 城市不再存有这一版，所以不画。文件本身不动。

compared_none.en: The two versions read the same text.

privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.en: Sets POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 in the current user's persistent environment, so PowerShell 7 started afterwards sends no usage telemetry. The original spelling lacked two underscores; the official name is written.
privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.zh: 在当前用户的持久环境变量中设置 POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1，此后新启动的 PowerShell 7 不发送使用遥测。原文拼写少了两个下划线，按官方名称写入。

privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.en: PowerShell stops reporting start-up and usage statistics to Microsoft.
privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.zh: PowerShell 不再向 Microsoft 报告启动和使用统计。

privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.en: Affects only PowerShell 7 started later; running processes, Windows PowerShell 5.1 and other programs are unaffected. sprawling scrubs the environment of the commands it starts, so the pwsh it launches does not inherit this variable.
privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.zh: 只影响之后启动的 PowerShell 7；已在运行的进程、Windows PowerShell 5.1 和其他程序不受影响。sprawling 为命令清洗环境，它启动的 pwsh 不继承此变量。

privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.en: Applies only to PowerShell 7 started afterwards, so open windows must be reopened. It covers the current user only; other accounts, services and scheduled tasks running as SYSTEM are not covered (a machine-wide variable needs an operation kind this version lacks). sprawling scrubs the environment of the commands it starts, so pwsh run by an Agent inside sprawling does not see this variable. Since PowerShell 7.5.7, turning off 'Send optional diagnostic data' in Windows also turns off PowerShell telemetry.
privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.zh: 只对之后新启动的 PowerShell 7 生效，已打开的窗口要重开；只覆盖当前用户，其他账户、服务和以 SYSTEM 运行的计划任务不受影响（整机变量需要本版没有的操作种类）。sprawling 给它启动的命令清洗环境，Agent 在 sprawling 里运行的 pwsh 读不到这个变量。PowerShell 7.5.7 起，在 Windows 里关闭“发送可选诊断数据”也会关闭 PowerShell 遥测。

privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply, or deletes only this variable if it was absent, then broadcasts the environment change again; processes already running are unaffected.
privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.zh: 写回应用前记录的值，或在原先不存在时只删除这个变量，然后再次广播环境变更；已经运行的进程不受影响。

privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.en: PowerShell 7 reads this variable on every platform, whatever the Windows edition; it has no effect on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
privacy_control_powershell_telemetry_opt.zh: PowerShell 7 在所有平台读取这个变量，与 Windows 版本无关；对 Windows PowerShell 5.1 没有效果。

privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_d.en: Disables the scheduled task Consolidator (Customer Experience Improvement Program). When the user has consented to CEIP, this task collects and sends usage data. It is disabled, never deleted; when the task is absent on this host the page says so and writes nothing.
privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_d.zh: 停用计划任务 Consolidator（客户体验改善计划）。用户同意参加 CEIP 时，该任务收集并发送使用数据。只停用，不删除；这台电脑没有此任务时显示“这台电脑没有此任务”，不写入。

privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_b.en: The task no longer collects and sends usage data on its schedule.
privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_b.zh: 该任务以后不再按计划收集和发送使用数据。

privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_a.en: The quality feedback the task provides is lost; the extra benefit after leaving CEIP is unknown.
privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_a.zh: 失去该任务提供的质量反馈；已退出 CEIP 时额外收益未知。

privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_o.en: By the task's own description it collects and sends data only when the user has consented to CEIP; on a machine where 'Turn off Windows CEIP' is applied, disabling it removes no further data. The task is disabled, never deleted.
privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_o.zh: 按任务自己的说明，只有用户同意参加 CEIP 时它才收集和发送数据；已应用“关闭 Windows 客户体验改善计划”的机器上，停用它不再多减少数据。只停用，不删除。

privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_u.en: Enables the task again if it was enabled before apply; if the task definition changed in between, nothing is written and the page reports a conflict.
privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_u.zh: 应用前任务是启用的，就重新启用；任务定义在此期间被改过时不写，页面报告冲突。

privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_e.en: Depends on whether the task exists on this host, not on the edition; the full path is resolved at run time and nothing is written when it is absent.
privacy_control_ceip_consolidator_task_e.zh: 取决于这台电脑是否有这个任务，与版本无关；运行时按完整路径解析，没有就不写。

privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_does.en: Disables the scheduled task UsbCeip (Customer Experience Improvement Program). When the user participates in CEIP it collects USB-related statistics and machine information and sends them to Microsoft. It is disabled, never deleted; when the task is absent on this host the page says so and writes nothing.
privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_does.zh: 停用计划任务 UsbCeip（客户体验改善计划）。用户参加 CEIP 时，它收集 USB 相关统计和这台电脑的信息并发给微软。只停用，不删除；这台电脑没有此任务时显示“这台电脑没有此任务”，不写入。

privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_benefit.en: The task no longer collects and sends USB statistics on its schedule.
privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_benefit.zh: 该任务不再按计划收集和发送 USB 统计。

privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_affects.en: Microsoft no longer receives USB statistics from this machine; no first-hand source says it affects how USB devices work.
privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_affects.zh: 微软收不到这台电脑的 USB 统计；没有一手资料说它影响 USB 设备本身的工作。

privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_overlooked.en: The task's own description says it does nothing when the user has not joined CEIP; with 'Turn off Windows CEIP' applied, disabling it removes no further data. It does not restrict USB devices or file access. The task is disabled, never deleted.
privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_overlooked.zh: 任务说明原文写明：用户没有加入 CEIP 时它什么都不做；已应用“关闭 Windows 客户体验改善计划”的机器上，停用它不再多减少数据。它不限制 USB 设备或文件访问。只停用，不删除。

privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_undo.en: Enables the task again if it was enabled before apply; if the task definition changed in between, nothing is written and the page reports a conflict.
privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_undo.zh: 应用前任务是启用的，就重新启用；任务定义在此期间被改过时不写，页面报告冲突。

privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_editions.en: Depends on whether the task exists on this host, not on the edition; the full path is resolved at run time and nothing is written when it is absent.
privacy_control_ceip_usb_task_editions.zh: 取决于这台电脑是否有这个任务，与版本无关；运行时按完整路径解析，没有就不写。

privacy_control_windows_ceip_title.zh: Windows 客户体验改善计划

privacy_control_windows_ceip_does.en: Enables the policy 'Turn off Windows Customer Experience Improvement Program', opting all users out of Windows CEIP. The letter O in the original is corrected to the digit 0.
privacy_control_windows_ceip_does.zh: 启用“关闭 Windows 客户体验改善计划”策略，所有用户退出 Windows CEIP。原文的字母 O 改为数字 0。

privacy_control_windows_ceip_benefit.en: Windows stops collecting usage information under CEIP.
privacy_control_windows_ceip_benefit.zh: Windows 不再以 CEIP 名义收集使用情况。

privacy_control_windows_ceip_affects.en: CEIP quality feedback is lost; other products' own telemetry is unaffected; 'similar keys' are not touched.
privacy_control_windows_ceip_affects.zh: 失去 CEIP 质量反馈；其他产品自己的遥测不受影响；“类似键”不处理。

privacy_control_windows_ceip_overlooked.en: The value runs opposite to its name: 0 opts out, and 1 would opt every user in. Turning CEIP off also turns off Application Telemetry and the Inventory Collector. CEIP is not the main Windows 10/11 diagnostic channel; the 'diagnostic data level' entry governs that.
privacy_control_windows_ceip_overlooked.zh: 值的方向与名字相反：0 表示退出，写 1 会让所有用户加入 CEIP。关闭 CEIP 时 Windows 同时关闭 Application Telemetry 和 Inventory Collector。CEIP 不是 Windows 10/11 主要的诊断数据通道，那由“诊断数据级别”一项管理。

privacy_control_windows_ceip_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_windows_ceip_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_windows_ceip_editions.en: Template: at least Windows Vista; CSP (ADMX_ICM/CEIPEnable): Windows 10 2004 with KB5005101 and later, Windows 11. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_windows_ceip_editions.zh: 模板：至少 Windows Vista；CSP（ADMX_ICM/CEIPEnable）：Windows 10 2004 + KB5005101 起、Windows 11。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_diagnostic_data_does.en: Sets the Windows diagnostic data policy to 0 (diagnostic data off). Only Enterprise, Education and Server editions treat it as off; other editions treat 0 as 1 (required diagnostic data only).
privacy_control_diagnostic_data_does.zh: 把 Windows 诊断数据策略设为 0（诊断数据关闭）。只有 Enterprise、Education 和 Server 版本按“关闭”执行；其他版本 Windows 把 0 当作 1（仅必需诊断数据）。

privacy_control_diagnostic_data_benefit.en: On supported editions, Windows and its components stop sending diagnostic data to Microsoft.
privacy_control_diagnostic_data_benefit.zh: 在支持的版本上，Windows 及其组件不再向 Microsoft 发送诊断数据。

privacy_control_diagnostic_data_affects.en: Microsoft and the organisation no longer receive update-failure, compatibility and reliability data, and management services that need diagnostic data (such as update reports) are affected; Windows Update and Defender stay on, and third-party programs are unaffected.
privacy_control_diagnostic_data_affects.zh: Microsoft 和组织收不到更新失败、兼容性和可靠性资料，依赖诊断数据的管理服务（如更新报告）受影响；不关闭 Windows Update 或 Defender，不影响第三方程序。

privacy_control_diagnostic_data_overlook.en: On Home and Pro the result is 'required diagnostic data only', not off. The 'Optional diagnostic data' switch in Settings is locked and the level cannot be raised; Settings may not display a 0 set by policy. On editions that honour 'off', update-failure information also stops reaching Microsoft. It covers Windows components only, not third-party or Microsoft 365 apps. A user-level twin policy exists; when both are set the more restrictive one applies.
privacy_control_diagnostic_data_overlook.zh: Home 与 Pro 上结果是“仅必需诊断数据”，不是关闭。设置中“可选诊断数据”开关被锁定，用户不能调高级别；设置页可能不显示由策略设的 0。在执行“关闭”的版本上，更新失败的信息也不再发给微软。只管 Windows 组件，不管第三方或 Microsoft 365 应用。同名用户级策略存在，两者都设时取更严格的一个。

privacy_control_diagnostic_data_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_diagnostic_data_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_diagnostic_data_editions.en: Value 0 means 'off' only on Enterprise, Education and Server; on other editions it equals 1 (required diagnostic data only), which is also the lowest level those editions offer. IoT Enterprise is not named. Windows 10 / Server 2016 and later.
privacy_control_diagnostic_data_editions.zh: 值 0 只在 Enterprise、Education、Server 上表示“关闭”；在其他版本上等同于 1（仅必需诊断数据），这也是那些版本能设的最低级别。IoT Enterprise 没有被单独点名。Windows 10 / Server 2016 起。

privacy_control_voice_activation_does.en: Force-denies activation of Windows apps by voice keyword (Windows 10 1903 and later).
privacy_control_voice_activation_does.zh: 强制拒绝 Windows 应用通过语音关键词被激活（Windows 10 1903 起）。

privacy_control_voice_activation_benefit.en: When no voice assistant is used, apps no longer wait for a wake word in the background.
privacy_control_voice_activation_benefit.zh: 不用语音助手时，应用不再在后台等待唤醒词。

privacy_control_voice_activation_affects.en: Apps that rely on a wake word cannot be woken by voice; ordinary recording, push-to-talk dictation and desktop programs' microphone access are not restricted by this item.
privacy_control_voice_activation_affects.zh: 依赖唤醒词的应用不能被语音唤醒；普通录音、按键听写和桌面程序的麦克风访问不受此项限制。

privacy_control_voice_activation_overloo.en: It does not turn off the microphone or restrict recording by apps (that is the 'apps access the microphone' entry); it binds Windows apps only, not desktop programs; the Settings switch for voice activation is locked.
privacy_control_voice_activation_overloo.zh: 不关闭麦克风，也不限制应用录音（那是“应用访问麦克风”一项）；只管 Windows 应用，桌面程序不受约束；设置中“允许应用使用语音激活”开关被锁定。

privacy_control_voice_activation_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_voice_activation_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_voice_activation_edition.en: CSP: Windows 10 1903 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_voice_activation_edition.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1903 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.en: Voice activation of apps while locked
Force-denies voice activation of Windows apps while the system is locked. The original's 'microphone hardware disabled' is inaccurate: this policy does not turn off the microphone hardware.
privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.zh: 强制拒绝系统锁定时 Windows 应用被语音激活。原文“麦克风硬件禁用”不准确：此策略不关闭麦克风硬件。

privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.en: Nobody can call an app by voice while the screen is locked.
privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.zh: 他人不能在锁屏状态下通过语音调用应用。

privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.en: Voice assistants cannot be used on the lock screen; once K12 denies activation this item adds nothing.
privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.zh: 锁屏时不能使用语音助手；K12 已拒绝时此项没有额外作用。

privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.en: The CSP says this applies only when voice activation itself is allowed; with the previous entry applied (voice activation denied) this entry adds nothing. The original's claim that it disables the microphone hardware at sign-in is not accurate.
privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.zh: CSP 写明本项只在“语音激活”本身允许时起作用；已应用上一项（语音激活 = 拒绝）时，本项不再增加效果。原文说它在登录时禁用麦克风硬件，这不准确。

privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.en: CSP: Windows 10 1903 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_voice_activation_above_l.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1903 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_location_provider_does.en: Enables the policy 'Turn off Windows Location Provider', which the template defines as no program on this computer being able to use the Windows Location Provider.
privacy_control_location_provider_does.zh: 启用策略“关闭 Windows 位置提供程序”：模板定义为这台电脑所有程序不能使用 Windows Location Provider。

privacy_control_location_provider_benefi.en: On the versions the template declares, programs cannot obtain location through the Windows Location Provider.
privacy_control_location_provider_benefi.zh: 在模板声明支持的版本上，程序不能经 Windows Location Provider 取得位置。

privacy_control_location_provider_affect.en: On Windows 8/8.1, location features that rely on this provider stop; on Windows 10/11 the effect is not documented first-hand.
privacy_control_location_provider_affect.zh: 在 Windows 8/8.1 上依赖该提供程序的定位功能失效；在 Windows 10/11 上效果没有一手说明。

privacy_control_location_provider_overlo.en: Windows' own template marks this 'Windows 8/8.1 only'; no first-hand source says whether it changes anything on Windows 10/11. Microsoft's Windows 10/11 connection-management guide turns location off with the 'turn off location (machine)' entry and never mentions this value. Applying it does not mean location is off.
privacy_control_location_provider_overlo.zh: Windows 自己的模板把这项标为“仅 Windows 8/8.1”；在 Windows 10/11 上它是否改变任何行为，没有一手说明。微软的 Windows 10/11 连接管理指南关闭定位用的是“关闭定位（整机）”一项，完全没有提到这个值。应用本项不能当作定位已经关闭。

privacy_control_location_provider_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_location_provider_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_location_provider_editio.en: Two first-hand sources disagree: the template says 'Windows Server 2012, Windows 8, Windows 8.1 only'; the CSP (ADMX_LocationProviderAdm) lists Pro, Enterprise, Education and IoT Enterprise on Windows 10 2004 with KB5005101 and later and Windows 11. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home.
privacy_control_location_provider_editio.zh: 两份一手来源不一致：模板写“仅 Windows Server 2012、Windows 8、Windows 8.1”；CSP（ADMX_LocationProviderAdm）列出 Windows 10 2004 + KB5005101 起与 Windows 11 的 Pro、Enterprise、Education、IoT Enterprise。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home。

privacy_control_location_feature_does.en: Turns off the Windows location feature (machine policy).
privacy_control_location_feature_does.zh: 关闭 Windows 定位功能（机器策略）。

privacy_control_location_feature_benefit.en: Programs cannot obtain this machine's location through the Windows location feature.
privacy_control_location_feature_benefit.zh: 程序不能通过 Windows 定位功能取得这台电脑的位置。

privacy_control_location_feature_affects.en: Navigation, automatic time zone, Find my device and other features that use system location stop working; websites can still infer the region from the IP address.
privacy_control_location_feature_affects.zh: 导航、自动时区、查找我的设备等依赖系统定位的功能失效；网站仍可按 IP 推断地区。

privacy_control_location_feature_overloo.en: Every location privacy switch is greyed out and cannot be changed; automatic time zone, Find my device and other location-based features stop. Windows still determines and shares precise location during an emergency call; a few features such as taskbar weather still estimate location from the IP address; desktop programs and third-party services may still estimate location from Bluetooth, IP or a cellular modem.
privacy_control_location_feature_overloo.zh: 所有定位隐私开关变灰，用户不能更改；自动时区、查找我的设备等依赖定位的功能停止。紧急呼叫时 Windows 仍会确定并共享精确位置；任务栏天气等少数功能仍用 IP 地址估计位置；桌面程序和第三方服务仍可能用蓝牙、IP 或蜂窝模块估计位置。

privacy_control_location_feature_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_location_feature_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_location_feature_edition.en: CSP (System/AllowLocation): Windows 10 1507 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_location_feature_edition.zh: CSP（System/AllowLocation）：Windows 10 1507 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_search_web_title.en: Web search option in Windows Search
privacy_control_search_web_title.zh: Windows 搜索的网页搜索选项

privacy_control_search_web_does.en: Stops Windows Search from offering web search.
privacy_control_search_web_does.zh: 禁止 Windows 搜索提供网页搜索。

privacy_control_search_web_benefit.en: What is typed into the Start menu search box is no longer sent as a web search.
privacy_control_search_web_benefit.zh: 在开始菜单搜索框里输入的内容不再作为网页搜索发出。

privacy_control_search_web_affects.en: Start menu search no longer shows web results; browsers and sprawling's search provider are unaffected. Official documentation covers Enterprise and Server.
privacy_control_search_web_affects.zh: 开始菜单搜索不再给出网页结果；浏览器和 sprawling 的搜索 Provider 不受影响。官方文档范围是 Enterprise 与 Server。

privacy_control_search_web_overlooked.en: It may have no effect on Windows 10/11; web results in Start and taskbar search are governed by the 'search does not use web results' entry.
privacy_control_search_web_overlooked.zh: 在 Windows 10/11 上可能没有效果；开始菜单和任务栏搜索的网页结果由“搜索不使用网页结果”一项管理。

privacy_control_search_web_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_search_web_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_search_web_editions.en: The template declares it for Windows Search 3.01 or later on Windows XP or Server 2003 and has no CSP mapping; only the Enterprise connection-management guide lists it for Windows 10/11 and gives the value 1.
privacy_control_search_web_editions.zh: 模板写明适用于 Windows XP 或 Server 2003 上的 Windows Search 3.01 及以后，没有 CSP 映射；只有面向 Enterprise 的连接管理指南把它列给 Windows 10/11，并给出值 1。

privacy_control_search_web_results_does.en: Makes Windows Search neither search the web nor show web results.
privacy_control_search_web_results_does.zh: 让 Windows 搜索不搜索网页、不显示网页结果。

privacy_control_search_web_results_benef.en: Search returns local results only, and input is not used for web queries.
privacy_control_search_web_results_benef.zh: 搜索只给本地结果，输入不用于网页查询。

privacy_control_search_web_results_affec.en: The official CSP does not support Pro; it does not guarantee the search component makes no network connection.
privacy_control_search_web_results_affec.zh: 官方 CSP 不支持 Pro 版；不能保证搜索组件没有任何网络连接。

privacy_control_search_web_results_overl.en: The value runs opposite to its name: 0 means no web search. On Pro web results keep appearing, and Home is not listed. It does not promise that the search component makes no network connection.
privacy_control_search_web_results_overl.zh: 值的方向与名字相反：0 表示不搜索网页。Pro 上网页结果照旧出现，Home 未列出。它不保证搜索组件完全不联网。

privacy_control_search_web_results_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_search_web_results_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_search_web_results_editi.en: The CSP (Search/DoNotUseWebResults) marks Pro unsupported and lists Enterprise, Education and IoT Enterprise, Windows 10 1803 and later; Home is not listed.
privacy_control_search_web_results_editi.zh: CSP（Search/DoNotUseWebResults）把 Pro 标为不支持，列出 Enterprise、Education、IoT Enterprise，Windows 10 1803 起；Home 没有列出。

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_tit.en: Tailored experiences from diagnostic data (current user)
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_tit.zh: 基于诊断数据的定制体验（当前用户）

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_doe.en: The original preference key is unverified; the official user policy 'Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences' is written instead.
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_doe.zh: 原项的偏好键未获证实，改写正式用户策略“不使用诊断数据提供定制体验”。

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_ben.en: Windows no longer uses diagnostic data to personalise tips and recommendations.
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_ben.zh: Windows 不再依据诊断数据推送个性化提示和推荐。

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_aff.en: Tips, suggestions and offers may still appear, only less relevant; diagnostic data collection does not stop.
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_aff.zh: 提示、建议和优惠仍可能出现，只是相关度更低；不停止诊断数据收集。

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_ove.en: Tips and offers may still appear, only less relevant; diagnostic data collection continues. It applies to the current user only, so each account applies it separately. It is written under HKCU\Software\Policies; whether a standard account may write there is not documented, and if Windows refuses, the page shows access denied and changes nothing. The original preference key is not written; Microsoft's formal user policy is.
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_ove.zh: 提示和推荐仍可能出现，只是相关性降低；诊断数据照常收集。只对当前用户生效，每个账户要各自应用。写在 HKCU\Software\Policies 下，标准账户能否写入没有文档说明，被拒绝时页面显示访问被拒绝，不做更改。原文的偏好键没有写，写的是微软正式的用户策略。

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_und.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_und.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_tailored_experiences_edi.en: CSP (Experience/AllowTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData): user scope, Windows 10 1703 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_tailored_experiences_edi.zh: CSP（Experience/AllowTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData）：用户作用域，Windows 10 1703 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_spotlight_title.zh: 全部 Windows Spotlight 功能（当前用户）

privacy_control_spotlight_does.en: ContentDeliveryManager is a container, not a value; the official user policy 'Turn off all Windows spotlight features' is written instead.
privacy_control_spotlight_does.zh: ContentDeliveryManager 是一个容器而不是一个值；改写正式用户策略“关闭所有 Windows 聚焦功能”。

privacy_control_spotlight_benefit.en: Spotlight lock-screen images, Windows tips and consumer feature suggestions are no longer downloaded, reducing that network traffic.
privacy_control_spotlight_benefit.zh: 锁屏聚焦图片、Windows 提示和消费者功能推荐不再下载，相关网络流量减少。

privacy_control_spotlight_affects.en: Spotlight images and tips are lost; the official CSP supports Enterprise and Education, not Pro; it does not cover every recommendation.
privacy_control_spotlight_affects.zh: 失去聚焦图片与提示；官方 CSP 只支持 Enterprise、Education，不支持 Pro；不覆盖所有推荐。

privacy_control_spotlight_overlooked.en: Microsoft marks Pro unsupported and does not list Home, so on those editions it most likely does nothing. Since October 2024 (KB5046633) the default desktop wallpaper can also be Spotlight. It applies to the current user only; it is written under HKCU\Software\Policies, and whether a standard account may write there is not documented. The original's ContentDeliveryManager is a key, not a value, and is not written.
privacy_control_spotlight_overlooked.zh: Pro 上微软标为不支持，Home 未列出，这两个版本上很可能没有效果。2024 年 10 月（KB5046633）起默认桌面背景也可能是 Spotlight。只对当前用户生效；写在 HKCU\Software\Policies 下，标准账户能否写入没有文档说明。原文的 ContentDeliveryManager 是一个键而不是值，没有写。

privacy_control_spotlight_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_spotlight_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_spotlight_editions.en: The CSP (Experience/AllowWindowsSpotlight) marks Pro unsupported; Microsoft's Spotlight configuration page says 'Windows spotlight is available on Windows Enterprise and Education editions only'; the template excludes Server. Home is not listed.
privacy_control_spotlight_editions.zh: CSP（Experience/AllowWindowsSpotlight）把 Pro 标为不支持；微软 Spotlight 配置页写明 “Windows spotlight is available on Windows Enterprise and Education editions only”；模板不适用于 Server。Home 没有列出。

privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.en: Turns off Microsoft online speech recognition.
privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.zh: 关闭 Microsoft 在线语音识别。

privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.en: Speech is no longer uploaded to the Microsoft online recognition service.
privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.zh: 语音不再上传到 Microsoft 在线识别服务。

privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.en: Windows online dictation and voice typing stop working; on-device recognition and third-party transcription (including sprawling's transcription endpoint) are unaffected.
privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.zh: Windows 在线听写和语音输入不可用；设备端识别和第三方转写（包括 sprawling 的转写 Endpoint）不受影响。

privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.en: Windows 11 voice typing (Win+H) uses online speech recognition and stops working; only on-device features such as Narrator remain. This is a preference the user can switch back in Settings at any time. Third-party transcription, including sprawling's own transcription endpoint, is unaffected. The 'online speech (policy)' entry is stronger and locks the switch.
privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.zh: Windows 11 的语音输入（Win+H）依赖在线语音识别，会停止工作；只保留讲述人等设备端功能。这是偏好，用户随时可以在设置里改回。不影响第三方转写，包括 sprawling 自己的转写端点。“禁止在线语音（策略）”一项更强，并锁定开关。

privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key.
privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。

privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.en: Documented only in Microsoft's connection-management guide for Windows 10/11 Enterprise and Server 2016/2019; whether Home and Pro read this value is not stated. Home and Pro have the same Settings switch.
privacy_control_online_speech_recognitio.zh: 只在微软面向 Windows 10/11 Enterprise 与 Server 2016/2019 的连接管理指南中有记载；Home、Pro 是否读这个值没有说明。设置页在 Home、Pro 上有同名开关。

privacy_control_feedback_notifications_d.zh: 隐藏 Windows 反馈请求通知。

privacy_control_feedback_notifications_b.en: Windows no longer pops up feedback questions on its own.
privacy_control_feedback_notifications_b.zh: Windows 不再主动弹出反馈问卷。

privacy_control_feedback_notifications_a.en: Only the feedback invitations are hidden; diagnostic data collection continues and the Feedback Hub can still be opened by hand.
privacy_control_feedback_notifications_a.zh: 只隐藏反馈邀请，不停止诊断数据收集，也不阻止手动打开反馈中心。

privacy_control_feedback_notifications_o.en: It only hides prompts asking for feedback; diagnostic and usage data are still sent (Microsoft: feedback frequency applies only to user-generated feedback), and Feedback Hub can still be opened by hand.
privacy_control_feedback_notifications_o.zh: 只隐藏请求反馈的通知；诊断和使用数据照常发送（微软原文：反馈频率只适用于用户主动提交的反馈），反馈中心仍可手动打开。

privacy_control_feedback_notifications_u.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_feedback_notifications_u.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_feedback_notifications_e.en: CSP (Experience/DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications): Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_feedback_notifications_e.zh: CSP（Experience/DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications）：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.en: Stops Windows from implicitly learning text from your typing (personal dictionary).
privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.zh: 停止 Windows 从你的输入中隐式学习文字（个人词库）。

privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.en: Names and words you type are no longer collected for personalisation.
privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.zh: 你输入的姓名和词语不再被收集用于个性化。

privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.en: Text recognition and word prediction become less personal; restoring the setting does not bring back learning data that was deleted.
privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.zh: 文字识别和词语预测的个性化程度降低；恢复设置不能找回已删除的学习数据。

privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.en: This is a user preference and can be switched back in Settings. Microsoft's recipe for turning off typing and inking data collection is the text and ink entries plus 'improve inking and typing recognition'; this entry is one of the three. Whether it deletes learned data is not documented. The machine policy form (which deletes stored data and locks Control Panel) writes two values at once and is not written in this version; see the candidate list.
privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.zh: 这是用户偏好，可以在设置里改回。微软关闭键入与手写数据收集的做法是文本、手写两项再加“改进墨迹书写和键入识别”一项，本项只是其中之一。是否删除已学到的数据没有文档说明。机器级策略形式（会删除已存数据并锁定控制面板）一次写两个值，本版不写，见候选清单。

privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key.
privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。

privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.en: Documented only in Microsoft's connection-management guide for Windows 10/11 Enterprise and Server 2016/2019; whether Home and Pro read this value is not stated.
privacy_control_implicit_text_collection.zh: 只在微软面向 Windows 10/11 Enterprise 与 Server 2016/2019 的连接管理指南中有记载；Home、Pro 是否读这个值没有说明。

privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.en: Stops Windows from implicitly learning from your handwriting.
privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.zh: 停止 Windows 从你的手写中隐式学习笔迹。

privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.en: Your handwriting samples are no longer collected for personalisation.
privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.zh: 你的笔迹样本不再被收集用于个性化。

privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.en: Handwriting recognition adapts less to your writing; restoring the setting does not bring back learning data that was deleted.
privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.zh: 手写识别对个人字形的适配降低；恢复设置不能找回已删除的学习数据。

privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.en: This is a user preference and can be switched back in Settings; it matters mainly on pen-capable devices (inference). Microsoft's recipe is the text and ink entries plus 'improve inking and typing recognition'. Whether it deletes learned data is not documented. The machine policy form is not written in this version; see the candidate list.
privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.zh: 这是用户偏好，可以在设置里改回；主要在有笔的设备上有意义（推断）。微软的做法是文本、手写两项再加“改进墨迹书写和键入识别”一项。是否删除已学到的数据没有文档说明。机器级策略形式本版不写，见候选清单。

privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key.
privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。

privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.en: Documented only in Microsoft's connection-management guide for Windows 10/11 Enterprise and Server 2016/2019; whether Home and Pro read this value is not stated.
privacy_control_implicit_ink_collection_.zh: 只在微软面向 Windows 10/11 Enterprise 与 Server 2016/2019 的连接管理指南中有记载；Home、Pro 是否读这个值没有说明。

privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.en: Prevents starting the handwriting recognition error reporting tool and sending its reports to Microsoft.
privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.zh: 禁止启动手写识别错误报告工具，也不向 Microsoft 发送其报告。

privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.en: Handwriting samples are not sent through that tool.
privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.zh: 手写样本不会通过该工具发出。

privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.en: That reporting channel is lost; other error reporting stays on.
privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.zh: 失去该报告渠道；不关闭其他错误报告。

privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.en: The tool belongs to the old Tablet PC Input Panel; its standalone template is gone from the 24H2 set, so it may have no effect on current Windows (inference). Other error reporting is unaffected.
privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.zh: 这个工具属于旧的 Tablet PC 输入面板；独立模板已从 24H2 模板集中移除，在当前 Windows 上可能没有效果（推断）。其他错误报告不受影响。

privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.en: The standalone template InkWatson.admx (at least Windows Vista) is only in the Server 2022 set; the 24H2 set writes this value only inside the 'Restrict Internet communication' umbrella policy; no CSP page was found (the constructed URL returned 404).
privacy_control_handwriting_error_report.zh: 独立模板 InkWatson.admx（至少 Windows Vista）只在 Server 2022 模板集里；24H2 模板集只在“限制 Internet 通信”总策略中写这个值；没有找到 CSP 页面（构造的地址返回 404）。

privacy_control_sensors_does.en: Turns off the Windows sensor feature (machine policy).
privacy_control_sensors_does.zh: 关闭 Windows 传感器功能（机器策略）。

privacy_control_sensors_benefit.en: Programs cannot read motion, orientation and environment sensors through the Windows sensor feature.
privacy_control_sensors_benefit.zh: 程序不能通过 Windows 传感器功能读取运动、姿态和环境传感器。

privacy_control_sensors_affects.en: Features that depend on sensors (such as auto-rotation or ambient light) may stop working; the sensor hardware is not powered off.
privacy_control_sensors_affects.zh: 依赖传感器的功能（如自动旋转、环境光）可能失效；不等于传感器硬件断电。

privacy_control_sensors_overlooked.en: The sensor hardware is not powered off; features built on sensors such as auto-rotation or adaptive brightness may stop (inference; Microsoft lists none). Whether it also blocks location is not documented; the 'turn off location (machine)' entry is the documented location switch.
privacy_control_sensors_overlooked.zh: 不关闭传感器硬件；自动旋转、自动亮度等依赖传感器的功能可能停止（推断，微软没有列出）。是否同时挡住定位没有文档说明，关闭定位看“关闭定位（整机）”一项。

privacy_control_sensors_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_sensors_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_sensors_editions.en: CSP (DisableSensors_2 in ADMX_Sensors): Windows 10 2004 with KB5005101 and later, Windows 11. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_sensors_editions.zh: CSP（ADMX_Sensors 中的 DisableSensors_2）：Windows 10 2004 + KB5005101 起、Windows 11。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_do.en: Stops Windows from tracking app launches to improve Start and search.
privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_do.zh: 停止 Windows 记录应用启动来改进开始菜单和搜索。

privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_be.en: Windows no longer records which programs you start most.
privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_be.zh: Windows 不再记录你常启动哪些程序。

privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_af.en: Start menu ordering by frequent use and launch suggestions stop; it may need a new sign-in to take effect; existing records are not deleted.
privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_af.zh: 开始菜单的常用程序排序和启动建议失效；可能需要重新登录才生效；不删除已有记录。

privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_ov.en: This is a preference, not locked, and can be switched back in Settings; whether existing records are deleted is not documented. The old policy 'Turn off user tracking' applies only to Vista and earlier and is not a substitute. The value for recently opened items in Start (Start_TrackDocs) has no documented type and is not written in this version.
privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_ov.zh: 这是偏好，不锁定，用户可以在设置里改回；已有记录是否删除没有文档说明。旧策略“关闭用户跟踪”只适用于 Vista 及以前，不是替代。开始菜单“最近打开的项目”对应的值（Start_TrackDocs）类型没有文档，本版不写。

privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_un.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key.
privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_un.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。

privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_ed.en: Documented only in Microsoft's connection-management guide for Windows 10/11 Enterprise and Server 2016/2019; whether Home and Pro read this value is not stated. The guide lists it among the Windows 10 1703 options.
privacy_control_start_launch_tracking_ed.zh: 只在微软面向 Windows 10/11 Enterprise 与 Server 2016/2019 的连接管理指南中有记载；Home、Pro 是否读这个值没有说明。指南把它列在 Windows 10 1703 的选项中。

privacy_control_input_personalization_do.en: Prevents users from turning on Microsoft online speech services. The lowercase l in the original is corrected to an uppercase I.
privacy_control_input_personalization_do.zh: 禁止用户启用 Microsoft 在线语音服务。原文小写 l 改为大写 I。

privacy_control_input_personalization_be.en: Speech is not sent to Microsoft online speech services.
privacy_control_input_personalization_be.zh: 语音不会发送到 Microsoft 在线语音服务。

privacy_control_input_personalization_af.en: Online dictation and apps that need online speech stop working, and users cannot turn them back on in Settings; keyboard input is unaffected.
privacy_control_input_personalization_af.zh: 在线听写和依赖在线语音的应用不可用，用户也不能在设置中再打开；不影响键盘输入。

privacy_control_input_personalization_ov.en: Despite the name InputPersonalization, it governs online speech, not typing or inking personalisation. Windows 11 voice typing stops and cannot be turned back on in Settings. With this applied, the 'online speech recognition (preference)' entry adds nothing.
privacy_control_input_personalization_ov.zh: 名字叫 InputPersonalization，管的却是在线语音，不是键入或手写个性化。Windows 11 语音输入停止，用户不能在设置里重新打开。应用本项后，“在线语音识别（偏好）”一项不再增加效果。

privacy_control_input_personalization_un.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_input_personalization_un.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_input_personalization_ed.en: CSP (Privacy/AllowInputPersonalization): Windows 10 1507 and later (semantics updated in 1809). The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_input_personalization_ed.zh: CSP（Privacy/AllowInputPersonalization）：Windows 10 1507 起（1809 调整语义）。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_steps_recorder_does.en: Turns off Steps Recorder (PSR.exe). The original path is incomplete; the official policy is written. Microsoft lists Steps Recorder as deprecated.
privacy_control_steps_recorder_does.zh: 关闭步骤记录器（PSR.exe）。原文路径不完整，按正式策略写入。Microsoft 已把步骤记录器列为弃用组件。

privacy_control_steps_recorder_benefit.en: Steps Recorder cannot capture screens and steps.
privacy_control_steps_recorder_benefit.zh: 步骤记录器不能截取屏幕和操作步骤。

privacy_control_steps_recorder_affects.en: This troubleshooting tool is lost; other screenshot or recording tools are not blocked; on systems where the component is removed the item has no effect.
privacy_control_steps_recorder_affects.zh: 失去这一故障复现工具；不阻止其他截图或录屏工具；组件已移除的系统上此项无作用。

privacy_control_steps_recorder_overlooke.en: Steps Recorder records keyboard and mouse input, UI data and screenshots. Microsoft has deprecated it and will remove it in a future release; where it is removed this entry has no effect. Snipping Tool, Xbox Game Bar and Clipchamp can still record the screen.
privacy_control_steps_recorder_overlooke.zh: 步骤记录器会记录键盘鼠标操作、界面数据和截图。微软已弃用它，将在未来版本移除，移除后本项没有效果。截图工具、Xbox Game Bar、Clipchamp 等仍能录屏。

privacy_control_steps_recorder_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_steps_recorder_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_steps_recorder_editions.en: CSP (ADMX_AppCompat): Windows 10 2004 with KB5005101 and later, Windows 11. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_steps_recorder_editions.zh: CSP（ADMX_AppCompat）：Windows 10 2004 + KB5005101 起、Windows 11。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_activity_feed_does.en: Stops apps and the system from publishing activity history and stops roaming it.
privacy_control_activity_feed_does.zh: 禁止应用和系统发布活动历史，并停止其漫游。

privacy_control_activity_feed_benefit.en: Activity records are no longer published or synced through the activity feed.
privacy_control_activity_feed_benefit.zh: 活动记录不再通过活动源发布和同步。

privacy_control_activity_feed_affects.en: Continue-where-you-left-off features such as the Windows 10 Timeline are affected (Windows 11 has no Timeline UI); existing history is not deleted, and browser history and OneDrive are unaffected.
privacy_control_activity_feed_affects.zh: Windows 10 时间线等连续任务体验受影响，Windows 11 已没有时间线界面；不删除已有历史，不影响浏览器历史或 OneDrive。

privacy_control_activity_feed_overlooked.en: Microsoft's recipe sets three values together: this one, 'publish user activities' and 'upload user activities'; with this one alone, local activities are still published. Existing history is not deleted; use 'Clear activity history' in Settings. Windows 11 has no Timeline UI, and activity upload ended in 2021 (Microsoft accounts) and January 2024 (Entra accounts), so on current Windows 11 the visible effect is small.
privacy_control_activity_feed_overlooked.zh: 微软的做法是三项一起设：本项、“发布用户活动”、“上传用户活动”；只应用本项时，本地活动仍会被发布。已有历史不会删除，需要在设置里“清除活动历史”。Windows 11 没有时间线界面，活动上传服务已于 2021 年（Microsoft 账户）和 2024 年 1 月（Entra 账户）停止，所以在当前 Windows 11 上可见效果很小。

privacy_control_activity_feed_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_activity_feed_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_activity_feed_editions.en: CSP (Privacy/EnableActivityFeed): Windows 10 1709 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_activity_feed_editions.zh: CSP（Privacy/EnableActivityFeed）：Windows 10 1709 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_location_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to location to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_location_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问位置的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_location_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get location by default.
privacy_control_app_location_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得位置。

privacy_control_app_location_affects.en: Navigation, weather and other automatic location features stop; IP-based location is unaffected. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_location_affects.zh: 导航、天气等自动定位功能失效；IP 定位不受影响。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_location_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessLocation_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Windows features that use location (automatic time zone, Find my device) are governed by the 'turn off location (machine)' entry, not by this one (inference).
privacy_control_app_location_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessLocation_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。使用定位的 Windows 功能（自动时区、查找我的设备）由“关闭定位（整机）”一项管理，不受本项影响（推断）。

privacy_control_app_location_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_location_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_location_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_location_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_account_info_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to account name, picture and other account info to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_account_info_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问账户姓名、头像等信息的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_account_info_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get account name, picture and other account info by default.
privacy_control_app_account_info_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得账户姓名、头像等信息。

privacy_control_app_account_info_affects.en: Apps cannot show your account name and picture; passwords, tokens and cookies are not protected by this. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_account_info_affects.zh: 应用不能显示你的账户姓名和头像；不保护密码、令牌或 Cookie。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_account_info_overloo.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessAccountInfo_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It does not protect passwords, tokens or cookies.
privacy_control_app_account_info_overloo.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessAccountInfo_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。不保护密码、令牌或 Cookie。

privacy_control_app_account_info_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_account_info_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_account_info_edition.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_account_info_edition.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_motion_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to motion data to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_motion_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问运动数据的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_motion_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get motion data by default.
privacy_control_app_motion_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得运动数据。

privacy_control_app_motion_affects.en: Fitness and activity-recognition features stop; with no motion sensor the item has no effect. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_motion_affects.zh: 健身、活动识别类功能失效；这台电脑没有运动传感器时此项无作用。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_motion_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessMotion_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It has no effect on a device without motion sensors.
privacy_control_app_motion_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessMotion_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。没有运动传感器的设备上没有效果。

privacy_control_app_motion_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_motion_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_motion_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_motion_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_phone_calls_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to making phone calls to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_phone_calls_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问拨打电话的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_phone_calls_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get making phone calls by default.
privacy_control_app_phone_calls_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得拨打电话。

privacy_control_app_phone_calls_affects.en: Apps cannot place phone calls; it is not a general limit on phone data or calling software. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_phone_calls_affects.zh: 应用不能发起电话；不是对手机数据或通话软件的总体限制。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_phone_calls_overlook.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessPhone_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It covers apps placing phone calls, not calling software in general.
privacy_control_app_phone_calls_overlook.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessPhone_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。只管应用拨打电话，不是对通话软件的总体限制。

privacy_control_app_phone_calls_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_phone_calls_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_phone_calls_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_phone_calls_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to trusted devices to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问受信任设备的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_bene.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get trusted devices by default.
privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_bene.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得受信任设备。

privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_affe.en: Device interactions that need this permission stop; paired devices are not removed and drivers are not restricted. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_affe.zh: 依赖此权限的设备交互失效；不撤销已配对设备，也不限制驱动程序。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_over.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessTrustedDevices_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Paired devices are not removed.
privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_over.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessTrustedDevices_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。已配对的设备不会被移除。

privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_edit.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_trusted_devices_edit.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_tit.zh: 应用与未配对设备通信

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_doe.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to communicating with unpaired wireless devices to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_doe.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问与未配对的无线设备通信的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_ben.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get communicating with unpaired wireless devices by default.
privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_ben.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得与未配对的无线设备通信。

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_aff.en: Apps cannot discover or talk to unpaired wireless devices; the original's 'sync' is broader than this; OneDrive and account sync are unaffected. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_aff.zh: 应用不能发现或连接未配对的无线设备；原项称“同步”，范围过宽；不影响 OneDrive 或账户同步。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_ove.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsSyncWithDevices_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It covers communication with unpaired wireless devices only, narrower than the original's 'sync'; OneDrive and account sync are unaffected.
privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_ove.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsSyncWithDevices_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。只管与未配对无线设备通信，比原文的“同步”窄；OneDrive 和账户同步不受影响。

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_und.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_und.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_edi.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_unpaired_devices_edi.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_titl.en: Apps read other apps' diagnostic info
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_titl.zh: 应用读取其他应用的诊断信息

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to other apps' diagnostic information to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问其他应用的诊断信息的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_bene.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get other apps' diagnostic information by default.
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_bene.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得其他应用的诊断信息。

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_affe.en: Diagnostic and resource-monitor apps are affected; this is not the setting that controls Windows sending diagnostic data to Microsoft (Windows 10 1703 and later). Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_affe.zh: 诊断或资源监视类应用受影响；这不是控制 Windows 向 Microsoft 发送诊断数据的设置（Windows 10 1703 起）。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_over.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsGetDiagnosticInfo_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It covers apps reading diagnostic information about other apps (including the user name); it is unrelated to Windows sending diagnostic data to Microsoft.
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_over.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsGetDiagnosticInfo_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。管的是应用读取其他应用的诊断信息（包括用户名），与 Windows 向微软发送诊断数据无关。

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_edit.en: CSP: Windows 10 1703 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_diagnostic_info_edit.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1703 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_contacts_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to contacts to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_contacts_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问联系人的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_contacts_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get contacts by default.
privacy_control_app_contacts_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得联系人。

privacy_control_app_contacts_affects.en: Contact completion and display stop; web services and exported contact files are not restricted. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_contacts_affects.zh: 联系人补全和显示失效；不限制网页服务或导出的通讯录文件。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_contacts_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessContacts_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Web contacts are unaffected.
privacy_control_app_contacts_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessContacts_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。网页通讯录不受影响。

privacy_control_app_contacts_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_contacts_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_contacts_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_contacts_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_calendar_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to calendar to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_calendar_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问日历的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_calendar_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get calendar by default.
privacy_control_app_calendar_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得日历。

privacy_control_app_calendar_affects.en: Calendar integration stops; browser calendars and separately authorised MCP calendar services are not governed by this. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_calendar_affects.zh: 日程整合失效；浏览器日历和单独授权的 MCP 日历服务不受此项控制。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_calendar_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessCalendar_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Web calendars are unaffected.
privacy_control_app_calendar_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessCalendar_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。网页日历不受影响。

privacy_control_app_calendar_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_calendar_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_calendar_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_calendar_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_call_history_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to call history to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_call_history_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问通话记录的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_call_history_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get call history by default.
privacy_control_app_call_history_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得通话记录。

privacy_control_app_call_history_affects.en: Call history display stops; existing records are not deleted. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_call_history_affects.zh: 通话记录显示失效；不删除已有记录。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_call_history_overloo.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessCallHistory_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Existing records are not deleted.
privacy_control_app_call_history_overloo.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessCallHistory_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。已有记录不会删除。

privacy_control_app_call_history_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_call_history_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_call_history_edition.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_call_history_edition.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_email_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to email to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_email_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问电子邮件的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_email_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get email by default.
privacy_control_app_email_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得电子邮件。

privacy_control_app_email_affects.en: Mail integration stops; browser mail, IMAP/SMTP programs and local mail files are not restricted by this. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_email_affects.zh: 邮件整合失效；浏览器邮箱、IMAP/SMTP 程序和本地邮件文件不受此项限制。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_email_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessEmail_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. IMAP/SMTP desktop mail programs and web mail are unaffected.
privacy_control_app_email_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessEmail_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。IMAP/SMTP 桌面邮件程序和网页邮箱不受影响。

privacy_control_app_email_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_email_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_email_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_email_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_tasks_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to user tasks (to-dos) to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_tasks_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问用户任务（待办）的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_tasks_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get user tasks (to-dos) by default.
privacy_control_app_tasks_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得用户任务（待办）。

privacy_control_app_tasks_affects.en: To-do integration stops; these tasks are not Windows scheduled tasks (Windows 10 1703 and later). Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_tasks_affects.zh: 待办整合失效；这里的任务不是 Windows 计划任务（Windows 10 1703 起）。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_tasks_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessTasks_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. These tasks are to-dos, not Windows scheduled tasks.
