privacy_control_app_tasks_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessTasks_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。这里的“任务”是待办事项，不是 Windows 计划任务。

privacy_control_app_tasks_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_tasks_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_tasks_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1703 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_tasks_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1703 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_messaging_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to reading and sending SMS/MMS to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_messaging_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问短信和彩信的读写的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_messaging_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get reading and sending SMS/MMS by default.
privacy_control_app_messaging_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得短信和彩信的读写。

privacy_control_app_messaging_affects.en: Messaging features that need this stop; it is not a limit on every chat program. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_messaging_affects.zh: 相关消息功能失效；不是对所有聊天软件的限制。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_messaging_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessMessaging_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It covers SMS and MMS, not chat programs.
privacy_control_app_messaging_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessMessaging_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。管的是短信与彩信，不限制聊天程序。

privacy_control_app_messaging_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_messaging_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_messaging_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_messaging_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_radios_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to controlling radios (Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switches) to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_radios_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问控制无线电（Wi-Fi、蓝牙开关）的默认设置设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_radios_benefit.en: Managed Windows apps (Store/UWP) cannot get controlling radios (Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switches) by default.
privacy_control_app_radios_benefit.zh: 受管 Windows 应用（商店/UWP）默认不能取得控制无线电（Wi-Fi、蓝牙开关）。

privacy_control_app_radios_affects.en: Apps cannot switch radios on or off; it is not airplane mode and does not stop connected programs from uploading. Per-app exception lists can still override the default; ordinary desktop programs are not bound by this policy.
privacy_control_app_radios_affects.zh: 应用不能开关无线电；不等于飞行模式，也不阻止已联网的程序上传。逐应用例外列表仍可覆盖默认值；普通桌面程序不受此策略约束。

privacy_control_app_radios_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers and meeting software are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessRadios_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It is not airplane mode; apps that are already connected still upload.
privacy_control_app_radios_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），浏览器、会议软件等普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessRadios_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。不是飞行模式；已经联网的应用照常上传。

privacy_control_app_radios_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_radios_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_radios_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_radios_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_error_reporting_does.en: Enables the machine policy 'Disable Windows Error Reporting': when software stops or fails unexpectedly, no problem report is collected or sent.
privacy_control_error_reporting_does.zh: 启用策略“禁用 Windows 错误报告”（整机）：程序意外停止或失败时，不收集也不发送问题报告。

privacy_control_error_reporting_benefit.en: Crash and failure reports no longer reach Microsoft or vendors that rely on WER.
privacy_control_error_reporting_benefit.zh: 崩溃与故障报告不再发给微软或依赖 WER 的厂商。

privacy_control_error_reporting_affects.en: Solution information is no longer offered in Security and Maintenance; vendors receive no crash reports from this machine.
privacy_control_error_reporting_affects.zh: “安全和维护”里不再提供解决方案信息；厂商无法收到这台电脑上的崩溃报告。

privacy_control_error_reporting_overlook.en: When this value is absent or 0, the ICM policy of the same name decides, then Control Panel; that policy also writes a second value, while this entry writes only this one, which the WER policy text says is sufficient. Turning diagnostic data off is a separate entry.
privacy_control_error_reporting_overlook.zh: 本值缺席或为 0 时，由“限制 Internet 通信”下的同名策略决定，其后才是控制面板；那条策略还写另一个值，本项只写这一个，WER 策略原文说这一个已足够。关闭诊断数据是另一项。

privacy_control_error_reporting_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_error_reporting_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_error_reporting_editions.en: Template: at least Windows Vista; CSP (ErrorReporting/DisableWindowsErrorReporting): Windows 10 1703 and later. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_error_reporting_editions.zh: 模板：至少 Windows Vista；CSP（ErrorReporting/DisableWindowsErrorReporting）：Windows 10 1703 起。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.en: Automatically declines Microsoft's requests for additional data after an error report, without notifying the user.
privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.zh: 自动拒绝微软在错误报告之后索取的附加数据，不通知用户。

privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.en: Additional data beyond the report (which may include files or memory content) is no longer sent.
privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.zh: 报告之外的附加数据（可能含文件或内存内容）不再发送。

privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.en: Microsoft cannot obtain the follow-up data needed to diagnose a reported crash.
privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.zh: 微软无法取得诊断某次崩溃所需的后续数据。

privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.en: It matters only while Windows Error Reporting stays on; with 'Disable Windows Error Reporting' applied it adds nothing.
privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.zh: 只在 Windows 错误报告仍开启时有意义；已应用“禁用 Windows 错误报告”时本项不再增加效果。

privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.en: Template: at least Windows Vista; the CSP has ErrorReporting/DoNotSendAdditionalData. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_error_reporting_addition.zh: 模板：至少 Windows Vista；CSP 有 ErrorReporting/DoNotSendAdditionalData。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.en: Enables 'Limit Diagnostic Log Collection': additional diagnostic logs are not collected even when more information is needed.
privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.zh: 启用策略“限制诊断日志收集”：需要更多信息时也不收集额外的诊断日志。

privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.en: Extra troubleshooting logs are no longer uploaded.
privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.zh: 额外的排错日志不再上传。

privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.en: Microsoft does not receive these additional logs.
privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.zh: 微软收不到这些附加日志。

privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.en: Microsoft: diagnostic logs are sent only when the device sends optional diagnostic data. With diagnostic data at Required, or the 'diagnostic data level' entry applied, there is nothing for this entry to stop; it guards against optional data being turned on later.
privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.zh: 微软原文：诊断日志只在设备设为发送可选诊断数据时才发送。诊断数据为“必需”或已应用“诊断数据级别”一项时，本项没有可阻止的东西，它防的是以后有人打开可选诊断数据。

privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 and later; CSP: Windows 11 21H2 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_diagnostic_log_collectio.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 起；CSP：Windows 11 21H2 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_dump_collection_does.en: Enables 'Limit Dump Collection': error reporting sends only kernel mini dumps and user-mode triage dumps, not full or heap dumps.
privacy_control_dump_collection_does.zh: 启用策略“限制转储收集”：错误报告只发送内核小型转储和用户态分诊转储，不发送完整或堆转储。

privacy_control_dump_collection_benefit.en: Full dumps, which can contain the memory of the crashed program, are no longer sent.
privacy_control_dump_collection_benefit.zh: 可能含崩溃程序内存内容的完整转储不再发送。

privacy_control_dump_collection_affects.en: Microsoft receives less complete crash dumps.
privacy_control_dump_collection_affects.zh: 微软收到的崩溃转储不完整。

privacy_control_dump_collection_overlook.en: Same condition as the previous entry: it acts only while optional diagnostic data is sent; with 'Disable Windows Error Reporting' applied no dumps are sent at all.
privacy_control_dump_collection_overlook.zh: 与上一项条件相同：只在发送可选诊断数据时起作用；已应用“禁用 Windows 错误报告”时完全不发送转储。

privacy_control_dump_collection_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_dump_collection_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_dump_collection_editions.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 and later; CSP: Windows 11 21H2 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_dump_collection_editions.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 起；CSP：Windows 11 21H2 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_application_telemetry_do.en: Enables 'Turn off Application Telemetry': stops tracking anonymous use of specific Windows components by applications.
privacy_control_application_telemetry_do.zh: 启用策略“关闭 Application Telemetry”：停止跟踪应用对特定 Windows 组件的匿名使用。

privacy_control_application_telemetry_be.en: Usage data collection by Application Telemetry stops.
privacy_control_application_telemetry_be.zh: 应用使用统计停止收集。

privacy_control_application_telemetry_af.en: No user-visible effect is documented; compatibility fixes are governed by a different policy that this entry does not touch.
privacy_control_application_telemetry_af.zh: 没有记载用户可见的影响；兼容性修复由另一条策略管理，本项不碰。

privacy_control_application_telemetry_ov.en: The value runs opposite to its name: 0 turns it off. It affects newly started programs; the template says to restart to stop collection for all programs. Application Telemetry is off whenever CEIP is off, so with 'Turn off Windows CEIP' applied this entry adds nothing. It is the formal counterpart, in the current templates, of the original's AitAgent task.
privacy_control_application_telemetry_ov.zh: 值的方向与名字相反：0 表示关闭。只对之后新启动的程序生效，模板说要重启才能对所有程序停止。CEIP 关闭时 Application Telemetry 本来就关闭，已应用“关闭 Windows 客户体验改善计划”时本项不再增加效果。这是原文 AitAgent 任务在现行模板中的正式对应。

privacy_control_application_telemetry_un.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_application_telemetry_un.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_application_telemetry_ed.en: Template: Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 and later; CSP (ADMX_AppCompat): Windows 10 2004 with KB5005101 and later, Windows 11. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_application_telemetry_ed.zh: 模板：Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 起；CSP（ADMX_AppCompat）：Windows 10 2004 + KB5005101 起、Windows 11。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_device_census_task_does.en: Disables the scheduled task Device Information\Device, which runs devicecensus.exe in system context on a schedule. It is disabled, never deleted; nothing is written when the task is absent.
privacy_control_device_census_task_does.zh: 停用计划任务 Device Information\Device：它定期以系统上下文运行 devicecensus.exe。只停用，不删除；这台电脑没有此任务时不写。

privacy_control_device_census_task_benef.en: DeviceCensus no longer reports device information through the diagnostic data endpoint on its schedule.
privacy_control_device_census_task_benef.zh: DeviceCensus 不再按计划经诊断数据端点上报设备信息。

privacy_control_device_census_task_affec.en: A managed device loses most of its information in Windows Update for Business reports; no first-hand source says other features on a personal device depend on it.
privacy_control_device_census_task_affec.zh: 被组织纳管的设备在 Windows Update for Business 报告里会缺少大部分设备信息；个人设备上没有一手资料说明其他功能依赖它。

privacy_control_device_census_task_overl.en: Disabling the task neither removes the program nor stops other components from calling it; how much it reports is also bounded by the diagnostic data level. Choose it together with the DeviceCensus user task to cover user context. It is the writable alternative to the firewall rule the original asked for.
privacy_control_device_census_task_overl.zh: 停用任务不删除程序，也不阻止其他组件调用它；它上报多少同时受诊断数据级别约束。要和“DeviceCensus 用户任务”一起选才覆盖用户上下文。原文要求的防火墙规则本版写不了，这是可写的替代。

privacy_control_device_census_task_undo.en: Enables the task again if it was enabled before apply; if the task definition changed in between, nothing is written and the page reports a conflict.
privacy_control_device_census_task_undo.zh: 应用前任务是启用的，就重新启用；任务定义在此期间被改过时不写，页面报告冲突。

privacy_control_device_census_task_editi.en: Depends on whether the task exists on this host, not on the edition; the full path is resolved at run time. Windows Update for Business reports themselves support Pro, Education and Enterprise only.
privacy_control_device_census_task_editi.zh: 取决于这台电脑是否有这个任务，与版本无关；运行时按完整路径解析。Windows Update for Business 报告本身只支持 Pro、Education、Enterprise。

privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.en: Disables the scheduled task Device Information\Device User, which runs devicecensus.exe in user context on a schedule. It is disabled, never deleted; nothing is written when the task is absent.
privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.zh: 停用计划任务 Device Information\Device User：它定期以用户上下文运行 devicecensus.exe。只停用，不删除；这台电脑没有此任务时不写。

privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.en: DeviceCensus user-context reporting stops on its schedule.
privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.zh: DeviceCensus 的用户上下文上报按计划停止。

privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.en: Same as the DeviceCensus system task.
Despite 'User' in its name it is a machine task that applies to every user; it is complete only together with the system task.
privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.zh: 名字里有 User，但它是机器上的系统任务，对所有用户生效；与系统任务一起选才完整。

privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.en: Enables the task again if it was enabled before apply; if the task definition changed in between, nothing is written and the page reports a conflict.
privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.zh: 应用前任务是启用的，就重新启用；任务定义在此期间被改过时不写，页面报告冲突。

privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.en: Depends on whether the task exists on this host, not on the edition; the full path is resolved at run time.
privacy_control_device_census_user_task_.zh: 取决于这台电脑是否有这个任务，与版本无关；运行时按完整路径解析。

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: .NET SDK 命令行遥测（当前用户）

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.en: Sets DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 in the current user's persistent environment, so .NET SDK commands started afterwards (dotnet build, dotnet run and so on) send no usage data.
privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: 在当前用户的持久环境中设置 DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1，之后启动的 .NET SDK 命令（dotnet build、dotnet run 等）不再发送使用数据。

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.en: The .NET SDK stops sending commands, partly hashed project information and CLI crash stacks.
privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: .NET SDK 不再发送命令、部分哈希过的项目信息和 CLI 崩溃的异常栈。

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.en: Only .NET SDK commands are affected; running an app with dotnet app.dll collects nothing anyway.
privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: 只影响 .NET SDK 命令；用 dotnet app.dll 运行应用本来就不收集。

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.en: Only processes started afterwards are affected; the single install-time telemetry entry already sent cannot be recalled (it must be set before installing). It covers the current user only. sprawling scrubs the environment of the commands it starts, so dotnet run by an Agent inside sprawling does not see the variable unless the building declares it. DOTNET_NOLOGO only hides the banner and is unrelated to telemetry.
privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: 只影响之后新启动的进程；安装 SDK 时已发出的那一次安装遥测无法撤回（要在安装前设置）。只覆盖当前用户。sprawling 给它启动的命令清洗环境，Agent 在 sprawling 里运行的 dotnet 读不到这个变量，除非 building 声明放行。DOTNET_NOLOGO 只关欢迎信息，与遥测无关。

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply, or deletes only this variable if it was absent, then broadcasts the environment change again; processes already running are unaffected.
privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: 写回应用前记录的值，或在原先不存在时只删除这个变量，然后再次广播环境变更；已经运行的进程不受影响。

privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.en: Independent of the Windows edition; every Microsoft distribution of the .NET SDK reads this variable.
privacy_control_dotnet_cli_telemetry_opt.zh: 与 Windows 版本无关；微软发行的 .NET SDK 都读取这个变量。

privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.zh: 改进墨迹书写和键入识别

privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.en: Disables 'Improve inking and typing recognition': inking and typing samples are no longer sent to Microsoft to improve language recognition and suggestions.
privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.zh: 停用策略“改进墨迹书写和键入识别”：不再把墨迹和键入样本发给微软用于改进语言识别与建议。

privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.en: Typing and inking samples no longer leave this machine.
privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.zh: 键入与手写样本不再离开这台电脑。

privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.en: The key is under Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies, not the usual SOFTWARE\Policies. Microsoft says this sending is turned off automatically when diagnostic data is at Basic or Security. It is the sending half; local learning is governed by the typing and ink entries.
privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.zh: 键在 Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies 下，不在通常的 SOFTWARE\Policies 下。微软说明诊断数据为基本或安全级别时，这项发送本来就自动关闭。它是发送的一半，本地学习由键入、手写两项管理。

privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1803 and later; CSP (TextInput/AllowLinguisticDataCollection): Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_linguistic_data_collecti.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1803 起；CSP（TextInput/AllowLinguisticDataCollection）：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.en: Enables 'Turn off handwriting personalization data sharing': the handwriting recognition personalisation tool does not send data to Microsoft.
privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.zh: 启用策略“关闭手写个性化数据共享”：手写识别个性化工具不把数据发给微软。

privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.en: Handwriting personalisation data is no longer shared with Microsoft.
privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.zh: 手写个性化数据不再共享给微软。
没有记载用户可见的影响。

privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.en: The standalone template ShapeCollector.admx is only in the Server 2022 set; the 24H2 set writes this value only inside the 'Restrict Internet communication' umbrella policy. No source says which current component reads it, so it may have no effect on current Windows. The 'handwriting error reports' entry is in the same position.
privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.zh: 独立模板 ShapeCollector.admx 只在 Server 2022 模板集里；24H2 模板集只在“限制 Internet 通信”总策略中写这个值。没有资料说当前哪个组件读取它，在当前 Windows 上可能没有效果。与“手写识别错误报告”一项情况相同。

privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.en: The standalone template (at least Windows 7) is only in the Server 2022 set; there is no CSP edition table.
privacy_control_handwriting_data_sharing.zh: 独立模板（至少 Windows 7）只在 Server 2022 模板集中；没有 CSP 版本表。

privacy_control_cloud_search_does.en: Sets 'Allow Cloud Search' to disabled: Windows Search and Cortana do not search cloud sources such as OneDrive and SharePoint.
privacy_control_cloud_search_does.zh: 把“允许云搜索”设为禁用：Windows 搜索和 Cortana 不搜索 OneDrive、SharePoint 等云端内容。

privacy_control_cloud_search_benefit.en: Search terms are no longer sent to signed-in cloud content sources.
privacy_control_cloud_search_benefit.zh: 搜索词不再发往已登录的云端内容源。

privacy_control_cloud_search_affects.en: Search results no longer include OneDrive, SharePoint or other cloud content.
privacy_control_cloud_search_affects.zh: 搜索结果里没有 OneDrive、SharePoint 等云端内容。

privacy_control_cloud_search_overlooked.en: It stops searching cloud content only; web results (two other entries) and search highlights are separate.
privacy_control_cloud_search_overlooked.zh: 只停止搜索云端内容，不停止网页结果（另有两项）和搜索亮点。

privacy_control_cloud_search_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_cloud_search_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_cloud_search_editions.en: CSP (Search/AllowCloudSearch): Windows 10 1709 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_cloud_search_editions.zh: CSP（Search/AllowCloudSearch）：Windows 10 1709 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_cortana_does.en: Disables 'Allow Cortana': Cortana is turned off and local search keeps working.
privacy_control_cortana_does.zh: 停用策略“允许 Cortana”：Cortana 被关闭，本地搜索照常。

privacy_control_cortana_benefit.en: Cortana no longer runs or handles voice and search requests.
privacy_control_cortana_benefit.zh: Cortana 不再运行，也不再处理语音或搜索请求。

privacy_control_cortana_overlooked.en: Microsoft has deprecated the standalone Cortana app; on current Windows 11 there may be nothing left to turn off.
privacy_control_cortana_overlooked.zh: 微软已弃用独立的 Cortana 应用；在当前 Windows 11 上可能没有可关闭的东西。

privacy_control_cortana_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_cortana_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_cortana_editions.en: CSP (Experience/AllowCortana): Windows 10 1507 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_cortana_editions.zh: CSP（Experience/AllowCortana）：Windows 10 1507 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_does.en: Disables 'Allow Cortana above lock screen': the system must be unlocked before talking to Cortana.
privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_does.zh: 停用策略“允许在锁屏上使用 Cortana”：必须先解锁才能用语音与 Cortana 交互。

privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_benef.en: Cortana cannot be used by voice while the system is locked.
privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_benef.zh: 锁屏状态下不能经语音使用 Cortana。

privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_affec.en: Cortana cannot be called by voice on the lock screen.
privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_affec.zh: 锁屏上不能用语音调用 Cortana。

privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_overl.en: As with the Cortana entry, the standalone app is deprecated; once the Cortana entry is applied this one adds nothing.
privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_overl.zh: 同“Cortana”一项，独立应用已弃用；应用“Cortana”一项后本项多余。

privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_editi.en: CSP (AboveLock/AllowCortanaAboveLock): Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_cortana_above_lock_editi.zh: CSP（AboveLock/AllowCortanaAboveLock）：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_search_location_does.en: Disables 'Allow search and Cortana to use location'.
privacy_control_search_location_does.zh: 停用策略“允许搜索和 Cortana 使用位置”。

privacy_control_search_location_benefit.en: Search no longer uses location for its results.
privacy_control_search_location_benefit.zh: 搜索不再按位置给出结果。

privacy_control_search_location_affects.en: Local results in Search (weather, nearby places) disappear.
privacy_control_search_location_affects.zh: 搜索里的本地结果（天气、附近地点）消失。

privacy_control_search_location_overlook.en: Narrower than 'turn off location (machine)'; with that entry applied this one adds nothing.
privacy_control_search_location_overlook.zh: 比“关闭定位（整机）”窄；已应用那一项时本项不再增加效果。

privacy_control_search_location_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_search_location_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_search_location_editions.en: CSP (Search/AllowSearchToUseLocation): Windows 10 1507 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_search_location_editions.zh: CSP（Search/AllowSearchToUseLocation）：Windows 10 1507 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_search_highlights_does.en: Disables 'Allow search highlights': the search box and search home show no online trending searches or daily content.
privacy_control_search_highlights_does.zh: 停用策略“允许搜索亮点”：开始菜单搜索框和搜索主页不显示在线的热门搜索与每日内容。

privacy_control_search_highlights_benefi.en: The search box no longer fetches online content.
privacy_control_search_highlights_benefi.zh: 搜索框不再拉取在线内容。

privacy_control_search_highlights_affect.en: Trending searches and daily content disappear.
privacy_control_search_highlights_affect.zh: 热门搜索与每日内容消失。

privacy_control_search_highlights_overlo.en: The value name EnableDynamicContentInWSB differs from the policy name, which makes manual checks confusing. It does not turn off web results. The Server 2022 template set does not have this policy.
privacy_control_search_highlights_overlo.zh: 值名 EnableDynamicContentInWSB 与策略名不同，手动核对时容易找错。它不关闭网页结果。Server 2022 模板集里没有这条策略。

privacy_control_search_highlights_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_search_highlights_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_search_highlights_editio.en: CSP (Search/AllowSearchHighlights): Windows 10 20H2–21H2 with KB5011543, Windows 11 21H2 with KB5023774, Windows 11 22H2 and later. The template is in the 24H2 set. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_search_highlights_editio.zh: CSP（Search/AllowSearchHighlights）：Windows 10 20H2–21H2 加 KB5011543、Windows 11 21H2 加 KB5023774、Windows 11 22H2 起。模板见于 24H2 模板集。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_consumer_features_does.en: Enables 'Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences': no personalised recommendations or Microsoft account notifications.
privacy_control_consumer_features_does.zh: 启用策略“关闭 Microsoft 消费者体验”：不显示个性化推荐和 Microsoft 账户通知。

privacy_control_consumer_features_benefi.en: Start suggestions, post-setup app installs and similar consumer content stop.
privacy_control_consumer_features_benefi.zh: 开始菜单推荐、初次设置后的应用安装等消费者内容停止。

privacy_control_consumer_features_affect.en: On editions that honour it, these suggestions and automatic installs no longer appear.
privacy_control_consumer_features_affect.zh: 在执行它的版本上，这些推荐和自动安装不再出现。

privacy_control_consumer_features_overlo.en: The ADML says it applies to Enterprise and Education only. On Home, Pro and Server it has no effect.
privacy_control_consumer_features_overlo.zh: ADML 原文：只适用于 Enterprise 和 Education。Home、Pro、Server 上没有效果。

privacy_control_consumer_features_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_consumer_features_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_consumer_features_editio.en: The ADML says 'This setting only applies to Enterprise and Education SKUs'; the CSP marks Pro unsupported; the template excludes Server.
privacy_control_consumer_features_editio.zh: ADML 原文“This setting only applies to Enterprise and Education SKUs”；CSP 把 Pro 标为不支持；模板不适用于 Server。

privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.en: Enables 'Turn off cloud optimized content': Windows experiences that use cloud optimized content show default content instead.
privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.zh: 启用策略“关闭云优化内容”：使用云优化内容的 Windows 体验改为显示默认内容。

privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.en: Those surfaces no longer download cloud content.
privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.zh: 这些界面不再下载云端内容。
部分界面显示默认内容。

privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.en: The CSP marks Pro unsupported and does not list Home. Microsoft's guide says to set it within 15 minutes of installing Windows; set later, content already cached may remain (inference). The guide gives an HKCU path, but the template declares a machine policy, so HKLM is written as the template defines.
privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.zh: CSP 把 Pro 标为不支持，Home 未列出。微软指南说这一项应在安装 Windows 后 15 分钟内设置，之后才设时已缓存的内容可能仍在（推断）。指南给的是 HKCU 路径，但模板声明为机器策略，这里按模板写 HKLM。

privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.en: CSP (Experience/DisableCloudOptimizedContent): Enterprise, Education, IoT Enterprise, Windows 11 21H2 and later; Pro marked unsupported. Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 and later. Home is not listed.
privacy_control_cloud_optimized_content_.zh: CSP（Experience/DisableCloudOptimizedContent）：Enterprise、Education、IoT Enterprise，Windows 11 21H2 起；Pro 标为不支持。模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 起。Home 未列出。

privacy_control_windows_tips_does.en: Enables 'Do not show Windows tips': no contextual pop-ups explaining how to use Windows.
privacy_control_windows_tips_does.zh: 启用策略“不显示 Windows 提示”：不弹出讲解 Windows 用法的上下文提示。

privacy_control_windows_tips_benefit.en: Tips chosen by Microsoft from diagnostic data stop.
privacy_control_windows_tips_benefit.zh: 微软按诊断数据挑选提示的这一过程停止。

privacy_control_windows_tips_overlooked.en: The ADML says it applies to Enterprise and Education only; on Home and Pro it has no effect. With diagnostic data at Basic or below, users see a limited set of tips even without it. The Tips app itself is deprecated.
privacy_control_windows_tips_overlooked.zh: ADML 原文：只适用于 Enterprise 和 Education；Home、Pro 上没有效果。诊断数据为基本级别或更低时，即使不设也只看到少量提示。“提示”应用本身已被弃用。

privacy_control_windows_tips_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_windows_tips_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_windows_tips_editions.en: The ADML says 'this setting only applies to Enterprise and Education SKUs'; the CSP (Experience/AllowWindowsTips) marks Pro unsupported; the template excludes Server.
privacy_control_windows_tips_editions.zh: ADML 原文“this setting only applies to Enterprise and Education SKUs”；CSP（Experience/AllowWindowsTips）把 Pro 标为不支持；模板不适用于 Server。

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: 云端消费者账户状态内容

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.en: Enables 'Turn off cloud consumer account state content': the related Windows experiences show default content.
privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: 启用策略“关闭云端消费者账户状态内容”：相关 Windows 体验显示默认内容。

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.en: Those experiences no longer fetch account-state content from the cloud.
privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: 这些体验不再取云端的账户状态内容。

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.en: Microsoft account status content (for example account notices) is not shown; the sources do not list which surfaces.
privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: 微软账户状态类内容（例如账户提示）不再显示；具体是哪些界面，来源没有列出。

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.en: The sources do not say which surfaces use this content, so the page can only repeat the template's words. The CSP marks Pro unsupported; the Server 2022 template set does not have this policy.
privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: 来源没有说明哪些界面使用这类内容，页面只能重复模板的措辞。CSP 把 Pro 标为不支持；Server 2022 模板集没有这条策略。

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.en: CSP (Experience/DisableConsumerAccountStateContent): Enterprise, Education, IoT Enterprise, Windows 11 21H2 and later; Pro marked unsupported. Home is not listed.
privacy_control_consumer_account_state_c.zh: CSP（Experience/DisableConsumerAccountStateContent）：Enterprise、Education、IoT Enterprise，Windows 11 21H2 起；Pro 标为不支持。Home 未列出。

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: Spotlight 中的第三方推荐（当前用户）

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.en: Enables the user policy 'Do not suggest third-party content in Windows spotlight'.
privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: 启用用户策略“不在 Windows Spotlight 中推荐第三方内容”。

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.en: Apps and content from third-party publishers no longer appear in lock-screen Spotlight, Start suggestions and tips.
privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: 锁屏 Spotlight、开始菜单推荐和提示里不再出现第三方发布者的应用与内容。

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.en: Suggestions about Microsoft features and apps may still appear.
privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: 仍可能看到关于微软功能和应用的建议。

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.en: With 'Turn off all Windows spotlight features' applied there is nothing left to filter. It applies to the current user only; it is written under HKCU\Software\Policies, and whether a standard account may write there is not documented; if Windows refuses, the page shows access denied.
privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: 已应用“关闭所有 Windows Spotlight 功能”时没有可过滤的内容。只对当前用户生效；写在 HKCU\Software\Policies 下，标准账户能否写入没有文档说明，被拒绝时页面显示访问被拒绝。

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.en: CSP (Experience/AllowThirdPartySuggestionsInWindowsSpotlight): user scope, Windows 10 1607 and later. The template excludes Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_third_party_suggestions_.zh: CSP（Experience/AllowThirdPartySuggestionsInWindowsSpotlight）：用户作用域，Windows 10 1607 起。模板标为不适用于 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_settings_online_tips_doe.en: Disables 'Allow Online Tips': the Settings app does not contact Microsoft content services for tips and help.
privacy_control_settings_online_tips_doe.zh: 停用策略“允许联机提示”：“设置”应用不联系微软内容服务取提示和帮助。

privacy_control_settings_online_tips_ben.en: Opening Settings pages no longer fetches tip content from Microsoft.
privacy_control_settings_online_tips_ben.zh: 打开设置页时不再向微软取提示内容。

privacy_control_settings_online_tips_aff.en: Online help and tips panes in Settings disappear.
privacy_control_settings_online_tips_aff.zh: 设置里的联机帮助与提示窗格消失。

privacy_control_settings_online_tips_ove.en: The key holds many other Explorer policies; restore touches only this value. It is a different control from 'Do not show Windows tips'.
privacy_control_settings_online_tips_ove.zh: 这个键里还有许多资源管理器策略，恢复只动这一个值。它与“不显示 Windows 提示”是不同的控制。

privacy_control_settings_online_tips_und.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_settings_online_tips_und.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_settings_online_tips_edi.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1709 and later; CSP (Settings/AllowOnlineTips): Windows 10 1709 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_settings_online_tips_edi.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1709 起；CSP（Settings/AllowOnlineTips）：Windows 10 1709 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_widgets_does.en: Disables 'Allow widgets': the whole Widgets feature, including its taskbar content, is turned off.
privacy_control_widgets_does.zh: 停用策略“允许小组件”：整个小组件功能（包括任务栏上的内容）关闭。

privacy_control_widgets_benefit.en: The Widgets news and feeds service no longer connects.
privacy_control_widgets_benefit.zh: 小组件的新闻与信息流服务不再连接。

privacy_control_widgets_affects.en: The Widgets board and the taskbar weather/news button disappear; Microsoft says apps using the service may stop working.
privacy_control_widgets_affects.zh: 小组件面板和任务栏天气/新闻按钮消失；微软说使用该服务的应用可能停止工作。

privacy_control_widgets_overlooked.en: This is the Windows 11 control; Windows 10 'news and interests' has no usable template and is not written in this version.
privacy_control_widgets_overlooked.zh: 这是 Windows 11 的控制；Windows 10 的“资讯和兴趣”没有可用模板，本版不写。

privacy_control_widgets_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_widgets_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_widgets_editions.en: CSP (NewsAndInterests/AllowNewsAndInterests): Windows 11 21H2 and later. The template excludes Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_widgets_editions.zh: CSP（NewsAndInterests/AllowNewsAndInterests）：Windows 11 21H2 起。模板标为不适用于 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_advertising_id_does.en: Enables 'Turn off the advertising ID': apps cannot use the advertising ID to link the user across apps.
privacy_control_advertising_id_does.zh: 启用策略“关闭广告 ID”：应用不能用广告 ID 跨应用关联用户。

privacy_control_advertising_id_benefit.en: The advertising ID is turned off, not just reset.
privacy_control_advertising_id_benefit.zh: 广告 ID 被关闭，不只是重置。

privacy_control_advertising_id_affects.en: In-app ads are no longer personalised by the advertising ID; the number of ads does not change.
privacy_control_advertising_id_affects.zh: 应用内广告不再按广告 ID 个性化，广告数量不变。

privacy_control_advertising_id_overlooke.en: Writing 0 is not 'on'; it hands the choice back to the user, so this page only writes 1 or deletes. Microsoft's guide also writes a separate preference value on its registry route; this entry writes only the policy value the template defines.
privacy_control_advertising_id_overlooke.zh: 写 0 不是“开启”，而是交还用户决定；本页只写 1 或删除。微软指南的注册表路线还另写一个偏好值，本项只写模板定义的策略值。

privacy_control_advertising_id_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_advertising_id_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_advertising_id_editions.en: Template: Windows 8.1 / Server 2012 R2 and later; CSP (Privacy/DisableAdvertisingId): Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_advertising_id_editions.zh: 模板：Windows 8.1 / Server 2012 R2 起；CSP（Privacy/DisableAdvertisingId）：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_language_list_websites_t.zh: 网站读取语言列表（偏好）

privacy_control_language_list_websites_d.en: Turns off 'Let websites provide locally relevant content by accessing my language list' (current user's preference).
privacy_control_language_list_websites_d.zh: 关闭“允许网站访问我的语言列表以提供本地相关内容”（当前用户的偏好）。

privacy_control_language_list_websites_b.en: Websites no longer receive the language list Windows offers.
privacy_control_language_list_websites_b.zh: 网站拿不到 Windows 提供的语言列表。

privacy_control_language_list_websites_a.en: Web pages may not pick the user's language automatically.
privacy_control_language_list_websites_a.zh: 网页可能不会自动选择用户的语言。

privacy_control_language_list_websites_o.en: This is a preference, not locked, and can be switched back in Settings; it applies to the current user only. It does not control what a browser itself sends.
privacy_control_language_list_websites_o.zh: 这是偏好，不锁定，用户可以在设置里改回；只对当前用户生效。它不控制浏览器自己发送的内容。

privacy_control_language_list_websites_u.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key.
privacy_control_language_list_websites_u.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。

privacy_control_language_list_websites_e.en: Documented only in Microsoft's connection-management guide for Windows 10/11 Enterprise and Server 2016/2019; whether Home and Pro read this value is not stated.
privacy_control_language_list_websites_e.zh: 只在微软面向 Windows 10/11 Enterprise 与 Server 2016/2019 的连接管理指南中有记载；Home、Pro 是否读这个值没有说明。

privacy_control_activity_publish_does.en: Disables 'Allow publishing of User Activities': apps and Windows cannot publish User Activity records.
privacy_control_activity_publish_does.zh: 停用策略“允许发布用户活动”：应用和 Windows 不能发布“用户活动”记录。

privacy_control_activity_publish_benefit.en: Activity history is no longer recorded locally, so there is nothing to upload or read later.
privacy_control_activity_publish_benefit.zh: 活动历史不再在这台电脑上记录，也就没有可上传或读取的记录。

privacy_control_activity_publish_affects.en: Features that resume work from activity history (Windows 10 Timeline) get no new entries.
privacy_control_activity_publish_affects.zh: 依赖活动历史的“从上次停下处继续”功能（Windows 10 时间线）不再有新记录。

privacy_control_activity_publish_overloo.en: Takes effect immediately; existing history is not deleted and must be cleared in Settings. Microsoft's recipe sets it together with 'activity feed' and 'upload user activities'.
privacy_control_activity_publish_overloo.zh: 立即生效；已有历史不会删除，需要在设置里清除。微软的做法是与“活动源”“上传用户活动”三项一起设。

privacy_control_activity_publish_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_activity_publish_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_activity_publish_edition.en: CSP (Privacy/PublishUserActivities): Windows 10 1709 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_activity_publish_edition.zh: CSP（Privacy/PublishUserActivities）：Windows 10 1709 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_activity_upload_does.zh: 停用策略“允许上传用户活动”。

privacy_control_activity_upload_benefit.en: Published activities are not uploaded to the cloud.
privacy_control_activity_upload_benefit.zh: 已发布的活动不会上传到云端。

privacy_control_activity_upload_affects.en: Nothing visible changes for a current user.

privacy_control_activity_upload_overlook.en: The upload service it governs has ended: Microsoft accounts could not upload new activity from July 2021 and Entra accounts from January 2024, so on today's service writing it changes nothing. Activity already uploaded is not deleted by it.
privacy_control_activity_upload_overlook.zh: 它管的上传服务已经停止：Microsoft 账户自 2021 年 7 月、Entra 账户自 2024 年 1 月起不能上传新活动，所以在今天的服务上写入不改变行为。已上传的活动不会因此删除。

privacy_control_activity_upload_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_activity_upload_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_activity_upload_editions.en: CSP (Privacy/UploadUserActivities): Windows 10 1803 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_activity_upload_editions.zh: CSP（Privacy/UploadUserActivities）：Windows 10 1803 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_clipboard_history_does.en: Disables 'Allow Clipboard History': clipboard contents are not kept in history (Win+V).
privacy_control_clipboard_history_does.zh: 停用策略“允许剪贴板历史”：剪贴板内容不再保存在历史中（Win+V）。

privacy_control_clipboard_history_benefi.en: After the next copy, earlier clipboard contents can no longer be paged back.
privacy_control_clipboard_history_benefi.zh: 下一次复制后，之前的剪贴板内容不再能翻回查看。

privacy_control_clipboard_history_affect.en: Win+V clipboard history and pinned items are unavailable; ordinary copy and paste keeps working.
privacy_control_clipboard_history_affect.zh: Win+V 剪贴板历史和固定项不可用；普通复制粘贴照常。

privacy_control_clipboard_history_overlo.en: Clipboard history is local memory, not the part that goes to the cloud; that is the 'cross-device clipboard' entry. The sources do not say whether cloud clipboard needs history, so the page does not claim this entry stops cloud sync. Takes effect immediately.
privacy_control_clipboard_history_overlo.zh: 剪贴板历史在这台电脑的内存中，不是上云的部分；上云的是“跨设备剪贴板”一项。来源没有说跨设备剪贴板是否依赖历史开启，所以本页不说本项也停止云同步。立即生效。

privacy_control_clipboard_history_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_clipboard_history_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_clipboard_history_editio.en: CSP (Experience/AllowClipboardHistory): Windows 10 1809 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_clipboard_history_editio.zh: CSP（Experience/AllowClipboardHistory）：Windows 10 1809 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_does.en: Disables 'Allow Clipboard synchronization across devices': clipboard contents are no longer uploaded for the same account's other devices to paste.
privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_does.zh: 停用策略“允许跨设备同步剪贴板”：剪贴板内容不再上传到云端供同一账户的其他设备粘贴。

privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_benefit.en: Copied content no longer leaves this machine.
privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_benefit.zh: 复制的内容不再离开这台电脑。

privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_affects.en: Pasting on another device what was copied here, and the reverse, stops.
privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_affects.zh: 在另一台设备上粘贴这台电脑复制的内容（及反向）不再可用。

privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_overlook.en: Local clipboard history (Win+V) is a separate entry; this is one of the formal counterparts of the original's 'cross-device sync'. Takes effect immediately.
privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_overlook.zh: 这台电脑上的剪贴板历史（Win+V）是另一项；这是原文“跨设备同步”的正式对应之一。立即生效。

privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_editions.en: CSP (Privacy/AllowCrossDeviceClipboard): Windows 10 1809 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_cloud_clipboard_editions.zh: CSP（Privacy/AllowCrossDeviceClipboard）：Windows 10 1809 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_continue_experiences_doe.en: Disables 'Continue experiences on this device': the device is not discoverable by the same user's other devices and takes no part in cross-device experiences.
privacy_control_continue_experiences_doe.zh: 停用策略“在此设备上继续体验”：这台电脑不被同一用户的其他设备发现，不参与跨设备体验。

privacy_control_continue_experiences_ben.en: The device no longer announces itself to other devices.
privacy_control_continue_experiences_ben.zh: 这台电脑不再向其他设备公布自己。

privacy_control_continue_experiences_aff.en: Opening apps and continuing tasks between this PC and other devices stops.
privacy_control_continue_experiences_aff.zh: 在这台电脑与其他设备之间打开应用、继续任务不再可用。

privacy_control_continue_experiences_ove.en: Takes effect after a restart, and so does restore. The template says the default when not configured depends on the Windows edition, so restoring to 'absent' may return to different states on different editions. It is not a master switch for all sync.
privacy_control_continue_experiences_ove.zh: 重启后才生效，恢复后也要重启。模板说未配置时的默认行为取决于 Windows 版本，所以恢复为“缺席”在不同版本上回到的状态可能不同。它不是所有同步的总开关。

privacy_control_continue_experiences_und.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control. A restart is needed afterwards.
privacy_control_continue_experiences_und.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。之后需要重启。

privacy_control_continue_experiences_edi.en: CSP (ADMX_GroupPolicy/EnableCDP): Windows 10 2004 with KB5005101 and later, Windows 11. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_continue_experiences_edi.zh: CSP（ADMX_GroupPolicy/EnableCDP）：Windows 10 2004 + KB5005101 起、Windows 11。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_does.en: Disables 'Phone-PC linking on this device': the PC cannot be linked to phones and removes itself from linked phones' device lists.
privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_does.zh: 停用策略“此设备上的手机与电脑连接”：这台电脑不能与手机连接，并把自己从已连接手机的设备列表中移除。

privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_benefit.en: The data flow between phones and this PC stops.
privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_benefit.zh: 手机与这台电脑之间的连接数据流停止。

privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_affects.en: 'Continue on PC' stops; the Settings button to add a phone is greyed out.
privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_affects.zh: “在电脑上继续”不可用；设置里添加手机的按钮变灰。

privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_overloo.en: Takes effect after a restart. Applying it removes the PC from phones' device lists; restore does not re-list it, so the phone may need to be linked again.
privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_overloo.zh: 重启后才生效。应用时这台电脑会从手机的设备列表中移除，恢复不会让手机重新列出这台电脑，可能要在手机上重新连接。

privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control. A restart is needed afterwards, and the phone may need to be linked again.
privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。之后需要重启，并可能要在手机上重新连接。

privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_edition.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1803 and later; CSP (Connectivity/AllowPhonePCLinking): Windows 10 1803 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_phone_pc_linking_edition.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1803 起；CSP（Connectivity/AllowPhonePCLinking）：Windows 10 1803 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_message_sync_does.en: Disables 'Allow Message Service Cloud Sync': cellular text messages are not backed up to or restored from Microsoft's cloud.
privacy_control_message_sync_does.zh: 停用策略“允许消息服务云同步”：蜂窝短信不备份到微软云，也不从云恢复。

privacy_control_message_sync_benefit.en: Text messages are no longer stored on servers outside the user's control.
privacy_control_message_sync_benefit.zh: 短信不再存到组织控制之外的服务器上。

privacy_control_message_sync_affects.en: On devices that have text messages, cloud backup and restore of them stop.
privacy_control_message_sync_affects.zh: 有短信的设备上，短信云备份与恢复停止。

privacy_control_message_sync_overlooked.en: It covers cellular text messages only; a PC without a cellular modem has nothing to sync. Chat programs and Phone Link are unaffected.
privacy_control_message_sync_overlooked.zh: 只管蜂窝短信；没有蜂窝模块的电脑上没有可同步的东西。不影响聊天程序或“手机连接”。

privacy_control_message_sync_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_message_sync_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_message_sync_editions.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1709 and later; CSP (Messaging/AllowMessageSync): Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_message_sync_editions.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1709 起；CSP（Messaging/AllowMessageSync）：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_do.en: Enables 'Disable OneSettings Downloads': Windows does not connect to the OneSettings service to download configuration.
privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_do.zh: 启用策略“禁用 OneSettings 下载”：Windows 不连接 OneSettings 服务下载配置。

privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_be.en: One periodic connection to Microsoft is removed.
privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_be.zh: 减少一个定期连接微软的通道。

privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_af.en: Microsoft: apps that use this service may stop working; which apps is not listed.
privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_af.zh: 微软原文：使用这项服务的应用可能停止工作；具体是哪些应用没有列出。

privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_ov.en: It does not reduce diagnostic data by itself. The failures it can cause are not specified.
privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_ov.zh: 它本身不减少诊断数据。可能出现的故障没有具体说明。

privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_un.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_un.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_ed.en: Template: Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 and later; CSP (System/DisableOneSettingsDownloads): Windows 11 21H2 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_onesettings_downloads_ed.zh: 模板：Server 2016 / Windows 10 1909 起；CSP（System/DisableOneSettingsDownloads）：Windows 11 21H2 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_find_my_device_does.en: Disables 'Turn On/Off Find My Device': the device and its location are not registered in the cloud.
privacy_control_find_my_device_does.zh: 停用策略“打开/关闭查找我的设备”：设备及其位置不登记到云端。

privacy_control_find_my_device_benefit.en: The device's location (and the last-use location of an active pen) is no longer uploaded.
privacy_control_find_my_device_benefit.zh: 设备位置（以及主动式笔最后使用的位置）不再上传。

privacy_control_find_my_device_affects.en: A lost or stolen PC can no longer be located or locked from account.microsoft.com; the pen's last-use location is not shown.
privacy_control_find_my_device_affects.zh: 丢失或被盗时不能从 account.microsoft.com 定位、锁定这台电脑；看不到笔最后使用的位置。

privacy_control_find_my_device_overlooke.en: This is a loss-protection feature; once applied, a lost laptop cannot be located. It does not turn off location (that is the 'turn off location (machine)' entry).
privacy_control_find_my_device_overlooke.zh: 这是防丢失的安全功能，应用后丢失的笔记本无法定位。它不关闭定位（那是“关闭定位（整机）”一项）。

privacy_control_find_my_device_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_find_my_device_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_find_my_device_editions.en: Template: at least Windows 10 (not Server); CSP (Experience/AllowFindMyDevice): Windows 10 1703 and later. The template excludes Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_find_my_device_editions.zh: 模板：至少 Windows 10（不含 Server）；CSP（Experience/AllowFindMyDevice）：Windows 10 1703 起。模板标为不适用于 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_delivery_optimization_do.en: Sets the Delivery Optimization download mode to 99 (Simple): HTTP only, no peering, no use of the Delivery Optimization cloud service.
privacy_control_delivery_optimization_do.zh: 把传递优化下载模式设为 99（简单）：只用 HTTP，不做对等共享，不使用传递优化云服务。

privacy_control_delivery_optimization_be.en: Update data is no longer exchanged with other PCs, and the Delivery Optimization cloud service is no longer contacted.
privacy_control_delivery_optimization_be.zh: 不再与其他电脑交换更新数据，也不再连接传递优化云服务。

privacy_control_delivery_optimization_af.en: Peer sharing of updates on the local network stops; updates still download from the source or a Microsoft Connected Cache server.
privacy_control_delivery_optimization_af.zh: 局域网内对等共享更新停止；更新照常从源站或微软缓存服务器下载。

privacy_control_delivery_optimization_ov.en: The default mode peers with PCs behind the same public IP that the Delivery Optimization cloud service finds. Value 0 also stops peering but still uses cloud metadata, so it protects less; value 100 is deprecated from Windows 11 and Microsoft says it can make some content fail to download, so this page never writes it.
privacy_control_delivery_optimization_ov.zh: 默认模式会与同一公网 IP 下由传递优化云服务找到的电脑对等共享。值 0 也不对等，但仍使用云服务的元数据，保护较少；值 100 微软说 Windows 11 起已弃用、可能导致部分内容下载失败，本页不写它。

privacy_control_delivery_optimization_un.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_delivery_optimization_un.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_delivery_optimization_ed.en: CSP (DeliveryOptimization/DODownloadMode): Windows 10 1507 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_delivery_optimization_ed.zh: CSP（DeliveryOptimization/DODownloadMode）：Windows 10 1507 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_do.en: Enables 'Prevent the usage of OneDrive for file storage'.
privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_do.zh: 启用策略“禁止使用 OneDrive 存储文件”。

privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_be.en: No file leaves this machine through OneDrive.
privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_be.zh: 没有文件经 OneDrive 离开这台电脑。

privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_af.en: OneDrive cannot be opened from the OneDrive app or the file picker; Store apps cannot use OneDrive; OneDrive no longer appears in the File Explorer navigation pane; files stop syncing with the cloud; the camera roll is no longer uploaded automatically.
privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_af.zh: OneDrive 应用和文件选择器打不开 OneDrive；商店应用不能用 OneDrive；资源管理器导航栏不再显示 OneDrive；文件不再与云端同步；相机胶卷不再自动上传。

privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_ov.en: This ends OneDrive on the PC, including cloud backup of Desktop and Documents; files that exist only in the cloud cannot be reached from File Explorer. It is one of the heaviest entries on the page. To keep OneDrive but stop its traffic until sign-in, see 'OneDrive traffic before sign-in'.
privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_ov.zh: 这会在这台电脑上结束 OneDrive，包括桌面/文档的云备份；只在云端的文件从资源管理器里打不开。这是本页影响最大的条目之一。只想在未登录时不联网，可选“OneDrive 登录前不联网”。

privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_un.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_un.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_ed.en: Template: Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 and later; CSP (System/DisableOneDriveFileSync): Windows 10 1703 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_onedrive_file_storage_ed.zh: 模板：Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 起；CSP（System/DisableOneDriveFileSync）：Windows 10 1703 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: OneDrive 登录前的网络流量

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.en: Enables 'Prevent OneDrive from generating network traffic until the user signs in to OneDrive'.
privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: 启用策略“用户登录 OneDrive 之前，不让 OneDrive 产生网络流量”。

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.en: For a user who never signs in, OneDrive stops contacting its service.
privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: 从不登录 OneDrive 的用户，OneDrive 不再联系服务。

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.en: Nothing changes for a user who signs in to OneDrive.
privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: 登录 OneDrive 的用户没有变化。

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.en: It is the lighter option for keeping OneDrive installed but unused. The key is shared with the OneDrive client; restore touches only this value.
privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: 这是保留 OneDrive 但不用时的较轻做法。键与 OneDrive 客户端共用，恢复只动这一个值。

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.en: Template SkyDrive.admx: Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 and later; no CSP edition table was found, so whether each client edition applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_onedrive_pre_signin_traf.zh: 模板 SkyDrive.admx：Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 起；没有找到 CSP 版本表，各客户端版本是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 通知网络使用（推送通知）

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.en: Enables 'Turn off notifications network usage': Windows disconnects from the Windows Push Notification Service (WNS) and apps cannot poll their services to update tiles.
privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 启用策略“关闭通知网络使用”：断开 Windows 与 Windows 推送通知服务（WNS）的连接，应用也不能轮询服务来更新磁贴。

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.en: Windows no longer connects to WNS at sign-in and no longer polls for tile updates in the background.
privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 登录时不再连接 WNS，后台不再轮询磁贴更新。

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.en: Apps and system features receive no notifications from the network (tiles, badges, toasts); an app running on the machine can still raise notifications locally.
privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 应用和系统功能收不到来自网络的通知（磁贴、徽章、弹出通知）；应用在这台电脑上运行时仍可在本地发出通知。

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.en: Push notifications from chat, mail and other apps do not arrive while those apps are not running. The CSP warns that MDM real-time tasks that rely on WNS (remote wipe, unenroll, remote find, mandatory app install) stop working. No restart is needed.
privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 应用未运行时，聊天、邮件等应用的推送通知收不到。CSP 警告：依赖 WNS 的 MDM 实时任务（远程擦除、取消注册、远程查找、强制安装）会失效。无需重启。

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.en: Template: Windows 8 / Server 2012 and later; CSP (Notifications/DisallowCloudNotification): Windows 10 1803 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_push_notifications_netwo.zh: 模板：Windows 8 / Server 2012 起；CSP（Notifications/DisallowCloudNotification）：Windows 10 1803 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_camera_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to the camera to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_camera_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问相机的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_camera_benefit.en: Packaged apps cannot use the camera.
privacy_control_app_camera_benefit.zh: 打包应用不能使用相机。

privacy_control_app_camera_affects.en: The built-in Camera app and packaged meeting apps cannot use the camera.
privacy_control_app_camera_affects.zh: 内置“相机”应用和打包版会议应用不能用相机。

privacy_control_app_camera_overlooked.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessCamera_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Desktop programs are governed by a separate Settings switch, and whether this policy also sets it is not stated; Microsoft says desktop programs might still access the camera when that switch is off. Windows Hello face sign-in is unaffected. To block the camera for everything, see 'disable camera devices'.
privacy_control_app_camera_overlooked.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessCamera_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。桌面程序由设置里的另一个开关管，本策略是否连带它没有说明；微软说桌面程序在开关关闭时仍可能访问相机。Windows Hello 人脸登录不受影响。要整机挡住相机，见“禁用相机设备”。

privacy_control_app_camera_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_camera_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_camera_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_camera_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_microphone_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps' access to the microphone to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_microphone_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用访问麦克风的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_microphone_affects.en: Voice input, packaged calling and meeting apps and Voice Recorder cannot record; videos recorded by packaged apps may have no sound (inference).
privacy_control_app_microphone_affects.zh: 语音输入、打包版通话/会议应用、录音机等不能录音；打包应用录的视频可能没有声音（推断）。

privacy_control_app_microphone_overlooke.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessMicrophone_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. Desktop programs are governed by a separate Settings switch, and whether this policy also sets it is not stated. Voice activation is governed by two other entries.
privacy_control_app_microphone_overlooke.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessMicrophone_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。桌面程序由设置里的另一个开关管，本策略是否连带它没有说明。语音激活由另外两项管理。

privacy_control_app_microphone_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_microphone_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_microphone_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1607 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_microphone_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1607 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_notifications_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps reading the user's notifications to 'force deny': apps cannot read all notifications you receive, including those of other apps, through the notification listener.
privacy_control_app_notifications_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用读取用户通知的默认值设为“强制拒绝”：应用不能经通知侦听器读取你收到的全部通知，包括其他应用的通知。

privacy_control_app_notifications_benefi.en: Other apps can no longer read the content of your notifications.
privacy_control_app_notifications_benefi.zh: 其他应用不能读到你的通知内容。

privacy_control_app_notifications_affect.en: Watch and phone companion apps and notification-mirroring packaged apps receive no notifications; when denied the API just returns an empty list and the app reports no error.
privacy_control_app_notifications_affect.zh: 手表/手机伴侣、通知镜像类打包应用拿不到通知；被拒绝时 API 只返回空列表，应用不会报错。

privacy_control_app_notifications_overlo.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessNotifications_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. This is not whether apps may send you notifications; they still can, so it does not reduce interruptions. Cloud push is a separate entry ('turn off notifications network usage').
privacy_control_app_notifications_overlo.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessNotifications_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。这不是“应用能否给你发通知”，应用照常可以弹出通知，本项不减少打扰。通知的云端推送是另一项（“关闭通知网络使用”）。

privacy_control_app_notifications_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_notifications_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_notifications_editio.en: CSP: Windows 10 1703 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_notifications_editio.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1703 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_background_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps running in the background to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_background_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用后台运行的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_background_benefit.en: Apps cannot keep running when not in the foreground, which reduces their chances to collect or upload data unseen (inference).
privacy_control_app_background_benefit.zh: 应用不在前台时不能继续运行，减少它们在你看不见时收集或上传数据的机会（推断）。

privacy_control_app_background_affects.en: The CSP warns that SMS, email and voicemail notifications from communication apps may stop and background mail sync may fail; Microsoft says Cortana, Search and others might not work as expected.
privacy_control_app_background_affects.zh: CSP 警告：通信类应用的短信、邮件、语音信箱通知可能不再工作，后台邮件同步可能失效；微软说 Cortana 和搜索等可能不按预期工作。

privacy_control_app_background_overlooke.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsRunInBackground_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. This is the costliest entry in the group: packaged mail, calendar and chat apps get no new messages once closed. Windows 11 removed the background apps page; each app's background permission is under Installed apps → Advanced options, and that section is hidden once the policy is set. Desktop programs keep running in the background.
privacy_control_app_background_overlooke.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsRunInBackground_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。这是本组代价最大的一项：打包版邮件、日历、聊天应用关窗后收不到新消息。Windows 11 已移除后台应用总开关页，每个应用的后台权限在“已安装的应用 → 高级选项”里，设了策略后那一节不再显示。桌面程序照常后台运行。

privacy_control_app_background_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_background_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_background_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1703 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_background_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1703 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.en: Apps capture the screen without the picker
Sets the default for Windows apps capturing the screen without the system picker to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.zh: 把 Windows 应用不经选择器直接截屏的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.en: Apps can capture only after you pick a window through the system picker each time.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.zh: 应用只能在你每次经系统选择器挑选窗口后截取画面。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.en: Packaged apps that rely on automatic capture (recording, remote assistance, screen reading or AI screen analysis) must ask you to pick a window each time, or fail.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.zh: 依赖自动截屏的打包应用（录屏、远程协助、读屏或 AI 识屏类）要每次手动选窗口，或直接失败。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessGraphicsCaptureProgrammatic_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It blocks neither picker-based capture nor desktop programs capturing through other APIs. The template claims Windows 10 support, but the CSP lists Windows 11 only, so it has no effect on Windows 10.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessGraphicsCaptureProgrammatic_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。不阻止经选择器的截屏，也不阻止桌面程序用其他 API 截屏。模板写支持 Windows 10，CSP 只承认 Windows 11，在 Windows 10 上写入无效。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。
