privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.en: CSP: Windows 11 21H2 and later; no effect on Windows 10. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_progr.zh: CSP：Windows 11 21H2 起；Windows 10 上无效。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.en: Sets the default for Windows apps removing the capture border to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.zh: 把 Windows 应用截屏时去掉提示边框的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.en: The border stays on during capture, so you can always see that capture is in progress.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.zh: 截屏期间边框始终显示，你总能看到自己正在被截取。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.en: Recording and streaming packaged apps cannot remove the border; the feature itself still works.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.zh: 录屏/直播类打包应用无法去掉边框；功能本身不受影响。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessGraphicsCaptureWithoutBorder_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It does not block capture, only keeps it visible; to block capture without the picker, see the previous entry. No effect on Windows 10.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessGraphicsCaptureWithoutBorder_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。本项不阻止截屏，只保证看得见；要阻止不经选择器的截屏，见上一项。Windows 10 上无效。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.en: CSP: Windows 11 21H2 and later; no effect on Windows 10. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_screen_capture_borde.zh: CSP：Windows 11 21H2 起；Windows 10 上无效。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_gaze_input_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps reading gaze position from an eye tracker to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_gaze_input_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用读取眼动仪视线位置的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_gaze_input_benefit.en: Apps cannot tell where you are looking on screen.
privacy_control_app_gaze_input_benefit.zh: 应用不能知道你在看屏幕的哪里。

privacy_control_app_gaze_input_affects.en: Packaged apps that rely on eye tracking cannot read gaze; for people who use an eye tracker as an accessibility input, this disables that aid (inference).
privacy_control_app_gaze_input_affects.zh: 依赖眼动的打包应用不能读视线；对用眼动仪做无障碍输入的用户，这会使辅助功能失效（推断）。

privacy_control_app_gaze_input_overlooke.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessGazeInput_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. On a PC without an eye tracker, writing it has no visible effect.
privacy_control_app_gaze_input_overlooke.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessGazeInput_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。没有眼动仪的电脑上写入没有可见效果。

privacy_control_app_gaze_input_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_gaze_input_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_gaze_input_editions.en: CSP: Windows 10 1803 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_gaze_input_editions.zh: CSP：Windows 10 1803 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_human_presence_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps reading presence sensors to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_human_presence_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用读取存在感应传感器的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_human_presence_benef.en: Apps cannot tell whether you are at the PC or looking at the screen.
privacy_control_app_human_presence_benef.zh: 应用不能知道你是否在电脑前、是否在看屏幕。

privacy_control_app_human_presence_affec.en: Packaged apps that read presence sensing get no data.
privacy_control_app_human_presence_affec.zh: 读取存在感应的打包应用拿不到数据。

privacy_control_app_human_presence_overl.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessHumanPresence_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. It matters only on devices with presence sensors that meet Microsoft's definition; OEM custom sensors are not governed by these privacy settings. Whether Windows' own lock-on-leave and wake-on-approach also turn off is not stated. The CSP says build 25000 and later (a preview build number; inference: Windows 11 24H2 among releases).
privacy_control_app_human_presence_overl.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessHumanPresence_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。只在内置符合微软定义的存在传感器的设备上有意义；OEM 自定义传感器不受这类隐私设置管理。Windows 自带的离开锁屏、靠近唤醒是否一并关闭没有说明。CSP 写 build 25000 起（预览版编号；推断正式版为 Windows 11 24H2 起）。

privacy_control_app_human_presence_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_human_presence_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_human_presence_editi.en: CSP: 10.0.25000 and later; the Server 2022 template set does not have this policy. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_human_presence_editi.zh: CSP：10.0.25000 起；Server 2022 模板集没有这条策略。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_titl.zh: 应用读取前台程序文字

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_does.en: Sets the default for Windows apps reading text content from foreground applications to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_foreground_text_does.zh: 把 Windows 应用读取前台程序文本内容的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_bene.en: Apps cannot read the text in other programs you are looking at.
privacy_control_app_foreground_text_bene.zh: 应用不能读取你正在看的其他程序里的文字。

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_affe.en: Packaged apps that read on-screen text (inference: AI assistants, translators, screen readers) lose that ability.
privacy_control_app_foreground_text_affe.zh: 依赖读取屏幕文字的打包应用（推断：AI 助手、翻译、读屏类）失去这项能力。

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_over.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessForegroundText_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. The two first-hand sources disagree on the minimum version: the template of a Windows 11 client (build 26220) says Windows 11 25H2 and later, the CSP says 21H2 and later; whether 21H2–24H2 apply it is unknown. The runner images' templates do not have it. Most screen-reading accessibility software is desktop software and is unaffected.
privacy_control_app_foreground_text_over.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessForegroundText_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。两份一手来源的最低版本不一致：一台 Windows 11 客户端（build 26220）的模板写 Windows 11 25H2 起，CSP 写 21H2 起；21H2–24H2 上是否执行未知。runner 镜像的模板里没有这一条。读屏类无障碍软件多为桌面程序，不受影响。

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_foreground_text_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_foreground_text_edit.en: Template (Windows 11 client, build 26220): Windows 11 25H2 and later; CSP: Windows 11 21H2 and later. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_app_foreground_text_edit.zh: 模板（Windows 11 客户端，build 26220）：Windows 11 25H2 起；CSP：Windows 11 21H2 起。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_camera_device_does.en: Disables 'Allow Use of Camera': camera devices on the machine are disabled.
privacy_control_camera_device_does.zh: 停用策略“允许使用相机”：整台电脑的相机设备被禁用。

privacy_control_camera_device_benefit.en: No program can use the camera, including desktop programs and external USB cameras.
privacy_control_camera_device_benefit.zh: 任何程序都不能使用相机，包括桌面程序和外接 USB 摄像头。

privacy_control_camera_device_affects.en: Video calls, code scanning and photos all stop; Windows Hello face sign-in may also stop (inference), and without a PIN or password sign-in may then be impossible.
privacy_control_camera_device_affects.zh: 视频会议、扫码、拍照全部失效；Windows Hello 人脸登录也可能无法使用（推断），没有设置 PIN 或密码时可能无法登录。

privacy_control_camera_device_overlooked.en: The value runs opposite to the AppPrivacy entries: 0 disables and 'absent' allows. It is the only camera control not limited to Windows apps, and the costliest.
privacy_control_camera_device_overlooked.zh: 值的方向与 AppPrivacy 相反：0 表示禁用，“缺席”表示允许。这是唯一不限于 Windows 应用的相机控制，代价也最大。

privacy_control_camera_device_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_camera_device_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_camera_device_editions.en: CSP (Camera/AllowCamera): Windows 10 1507 and later. The template also names Server. Microsoft's CSP edition table does not list Home; whether Home applies it is not stated.
privacy_control_camera_device_editions.zh: CSP（Camera/AllowCamera）：Windows 10 1507 起。模板也列出 Server。微软的 CSP 版本表没有列出 Home，Home 上是否执行没有说明。

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_tit.en: Apps use Windows text and image generation
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_tit.zh: 应用使用 Windows 文本与图像生成

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_doe.en: Sets the default for Windows apps using Windows text and image generation to 'force deny'.
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_doe.zh: 把 Windows 应用使用 Windows 文本与图像生成功能的默认值设为“强制拒绝”。

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_ben.en: Apps cannot call Windows' built-in generative models on your content.
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_ben.zh: 应用不能调用 Windows 内置的生成式模型处理你的内容。

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_aff.en: Packaged apps that call these features lose them.
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_aff.zh: 调用这类功能的打包应用失去它。

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_ove.en: Binds Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs are not bound. Per-app exception lists (LetAppsAccessSystemAIModels_ForceAllowTheseApps and the others) override this default; the page reads and shows them and never writes them. The matching Settings switch is locked; an app that is already running is affected only after it restarts. The CSP page has no entry for it, so there is no edition table; the first build with the feature is not stated, and on systems without the feature writing it has no effect. Cloud AI services and models bundled with desktop programs are unaffected.
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_ove.zh: 只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用），普通桌面程序不受约束。按应用的例外列表（LetAppsAccessSystemAIModels_ForceAllowTheseApps 等）优先于这个默认值，本页读取并显示这些列表，不写入。设置中对应开关被锁定；正在运行的应用要重启后才受影响。CSP 页没有这一条，所以没有版本表；功能从哪个 build 起存在没有说明，没有该功能的系统上写入无效。不影响云端 AI 服务和桌面程序自带的模型。

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_und.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_und.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_edi.en: Only in the 24H2 template set and the templates of a Windows 11 client (build 26220); the CSP has no entry, so editions and minimum build are unknown.
privacy_control_app_system_ai_models_edi.zh: 只出现在 24H2 模板集和一台 Windows 11 客户端（build 26220）的模板中；CSP 没有这一条，版本与最低 build 未知。

privacy_control_recall_snapshots_does.en: Enables 'Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall': screen snapshots are no longer saved for Recall.
privacy_control_recall_snapshots_does.zh: 启用策略“关闭为 Recall 保存快照”：屏幕快照不再为 Recall 保存。

privacy_control_recall_snapshots_benefit.en: No more screen snapshots are saved, and those already saved are deleted.
privacy_control_recall_snapshots_benefit.zh: 不再保存屏幕快照，已保存的快照被删除。

privacy_control_recall_snapshots_affects.en: Recall's timeline and search of past screens are unavailable.
privacy_control_recall_snapshots_affects.zh: Recall 的时间线和对以往屏幕的搜索不可用。

privacy_control_recall_snapshots_overloo.en: Snapshots already saved are deleted when it is applied, and restore cannot bring them back. Recall exists only on Copilot+ PCs; elsewhere this entry has no effect. Recall processing is local and snapshots are not sent to Microsoft, but it occasionally fetches icons and metadata from the internet for the top-level domain of a snapshot URL.
privacy_control_recall_snapshots_overloo.zh: 应用时已保存的快照会被删除，恢复不能找回。Recall 只在 Copilot+ PC 上存在，其他电脑上本项没有效果。Recall 的处理在本地，快照不发给微软，但会偶尔按快照里网址的顶级域名从网上取图标等资料。

privacy_control_recall_snapshots_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control. Deleted snapshots do not come back.
privacy_control_recall_snapshots_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。已删除的快照不会恢复。

privacy_control_recall_snapshots_edition.en: Template: Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise/Education with Windows Sandbox, not Server; CSP: Windows 11 24H2 with KB5055627 (26100.3915) and later; Recall exists only on Copilot+ PCs. Home is not named.
privacy_control_recall_snapshots_edition.zh: 模板：Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise/Education（带 Windows 沙盒），不适用于 Server；CSP：Windows 11 24H2 加 KB5055627（26100.3915）起；只在 Copilot+ PC 上有 Recall。Home 没有被点名。

privacy_control_recall_component_does.en: Disables 'Allow Recall to be enabled': the Recall component is disabled and its files are removed from the device.
privacy_control_recall_component_does.zh: 停用策略“允许启用 Recall”：Recall 组件处于停用状态，其文件从设备移除。

privacy_control_recall_component_benefit.en: Recall is unavailable as a whole and the user cannot opt in.
privacy_control_recall_component_benefit.zh: Recall 整体不可用，用户也不能选择加入。

privacy_control_recall_component_affects.en: All of Recall stops; removal needs a restart.
privacy_control_recall_component_affects.zh: Recall 全部功能停止；移除需要重启。

privacy_control_recall_component_overloo.en: Applying it deletes saved snapshots and needs a restart. Restore (deleting the value) returns to 'not configured', which the template describes as the Recall component being disabled; whether removed files come back is not documented, and the optional feature may need reinstalling. It matters only on Copilot+ PCs.
privacy_control_recall_component_overloo.zh: 应用时删除已保存的快照，并要重启。恢复（删除这个值）回到“未配置”，模板说那时 Recall 组件处于停用状态；被移除的文件是否回来没有文档，可能需要重新安装可选功能。只在 Copilot+ PC 上有意义。

privacy_control_recall_component_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control. Deleted snapshots do not come back, the removed component may need reinstalling, and a restart is needed.
privacy_control_recall_component_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。已删除的快照不会恢复，被移除的组件可能需要重新安装，并需要重启。

privacy_control_recall_component_edition.en: Template: at least Windows 11 Pro, Enterprise or Education with Windows Sandbox, not Server; Home is not named. Only in the 24H2 template set.
privacy_control_recall_component_edition.zh: 模板：至少 Windows 11 Pro、Enterprise 或 Education（带 Windows 沙盒），不适用于 Server；Home 没有被点名。只在 24H2 模板集中。

privacy_control_click_to_do_does.en: Enables 'Disable Click to Do': the Click to Do component and its entry points are unavailable.
privacy_control_click_to_do_does.zh: 启用策略“禁用 Click to Do”：Click to Do 组件和入口不可用。

privacy_control_click_to_do_benefit.en: Screen content is no longer captured and analysed.
privacy_control_click_to_do_benefit.zh: 屏幕内容不再被截图分析。

privacy_control_click_to_do_affects.en: Win+Q / Win+click actions on screen content are unavailable.
privacy_control_click_to_do_affects.zh: Win+Q / Win+单击 的屏幕操作不可用。

privacy_control_click_to_do_overlooked.en: Analysis is local; content leaves the device only when you choose an online action such as 'Search the web' (sent to Bing), so the privacy gain is no screenshot analysis rather than less upload. It does not affect Click to Do inside Recall. The CSP lists Windows Insider Preview only; support on release builds is shown only by the template's presence in the 24H2 set. A Copilot+ PC is required.
privacy_control_click_to_do_overlooked.zh: 分析在本地进行，只有你选择“在网上搜索”这类在线操作时内容才离开设备（发给 Bing），所以隐私收益在于不截图分析，而不在于减少上传。本策略不影响 Recall 里的 Click to Do。CSP 只列 Windows Insider 预览版，正式版是否执行只由 24H2 模板的存在说明。需要 Copilot+ PC。

privacy_control_click_to_do_undo.en: Writes back the value recorded before apply (same type and bytes); if the value was absent before apply, deletes only this value and keeps the key. The matching Settings switch returns to user control.
privacy_control_click_to_do_undo.zh: 写回应用前记录的值（同类型、同字节）；应用前该值不存在时，只删除这一个值，保留键。设置中对应开关回到用户控制。

privacy_control_click_to_do_editions.en: Template: at least Windows 11 Pro, Enterprise or Education with Windows Sandbox, not Server; Home is not named. Only in the 24H2 template set.
privacy_control_click_to_do_editions.zh: 模板：至少 Windows 11 Pro、Enterprise 或 Education（带 Windows 沙盒），不适用于 Server；Home 没有被点名。只在 24H2 模板集中。

privacy_original_k02_reason.en: No program that reads TELEMETRY_OPT_IN_OUT was found: none of the three template sets contains the name and earlier research found no reader; not finding it does not prove absence, so it is undeterminable. Real switches of this kind have their own names, such as DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT for the .NET SDK and POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT for PowerShell 7, both listed separately on this page.
privacy_original_k02_reason.zh: 没有找到读取 TELEMETRY_OPT_IN_OUT 的程序：三套模板都不含这个名字，此前的研究也没有找到读取方；搜不到不能证明不存在，所以判为无法确定。真实的同类开关各有名字，例如 .NET SDK 的 DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT 与 PowerShell 7 的 POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT，二者在本页另列。

privacy_original_k03_reason.en: Blocking DeviceCensus.exe from the network needs a Windows Firewall outbound rule, which this version's writer cannot create. The writable alternative is to disable the two scheduled tasks that run it (Device Information\Device and Device User), listed separately; that stops its scheduled runs but is not a firewall-level guarantee.
privacy_original_k03_reason.zh: 阻止 DeviceCensus.exe 联网要用 Windows 防火墙出站规则，本版的写入器没有这种操作。可写的替代是停用调用它的两个计划任务（Device Information\Device 与 Device User），本页另列；那会让它不再按计划运行，但不是防火墙级的保证。

privacy_original_k04_reason.en: Neither current runner image (162 tasks on Server 2022, 209 on Server 2025) has an AitAgent task, and no Microsoft document defines it. The formal switch in the current templates is 'Turn off Application Telemetry' (AITEnable), listed separately.
privacy_original_k04_reason.zh: 两个现行 runner 镜像（Server 2022 共 162 个任务、Server 2025 共 209 个）都没有 AitAgent 任务，微软文档也没有定义它。现行模板中对应的正式开关是“关闭 Application Telemetry”（AITEnable），本页另列。

privacy_original_k06_reason.en: The CEIP task folder on the Server 2022 and Server 2025 images and on a Windows 11 client (build 26220) holds only Consolidator and UsbCeip, no KernelCeipTask. The formal CEIP switch 'Turn off Windows CEIP' is writable.
privacy_original_k06_reason.zh: Server 2022、Server 2025 镜像和一台 Windows 11 客户端（build 26220）的客户体验改善计划文件夹里只有 Consolidator 和 UsbCeip，没有 KernelCeipTask。CEIP 的正式总开关“关闭 Windows 客户体验改善计划”已可写。

privacy_original_k09_reason.en: 'Stop SQM completely' is an outcome, not a setting; no single switch covers every product. The formal Windows CEIP opt-out and Application Telemetry are writable, but together they do not cover the SQM of every program; Office and others have their own switches.
privacy_original_k09_reason.zh: “完全停止 SQM”是一个效果诉求，不是一个设置，没有覆盖所有产品的单一开关。Windows CEIP 的正式退出与 Application Telemetry 两项已可写，但加起来也不等于所有软件的 SQM，Office 等软件各有自己的开关。

privacy_original_k11_reason.en: Neither the three template sets nor the Privacy area of the Policy CSP contains AgentActivationEnabled, so no formal location or reader was found. The formal policies for the same purpose, app voice activation and voice activation above lock, are writable.
privacy_original_k11_reason.zh: 三套模板和策略 CSP 的 Privacy 区都没有 AgentActivationEnabled，找不到正式位置和读取方。同一目的的正式策略是“应用语音激活”与“锁屏时语音激活”，已可写。

privacy_original_k26_reason.en: The policy 'Turn off Inventory Collector' exists (AppCompat\DisableInventory), but the template gives no enabled value and no Microsoft document states what type and value are written when it is omitted, so it cannot be written. The template also says the Inventory Collector is off whenever CEIP is off, which the writable 'Turn off Windows CEIP' entry covers.
privacy_original_k26_reason.zh: 策略“关闭 Inventory Collector”存在（AppCompat\DisableInventory），但模板没有给出启用值，微软文档也没有规定省略时写入什么类型和值，所以不能写。模板说明另有一句：CEIP 关闭时 Inventory Collector 本来就关闭，已可写的“关闭 Windows 客户体验改善计划”一项覆盖这个效果。

privacy_original_k39_reason.en: No current template set or Policy CSP has AllowCrossDeviceSync. Cross-device sync in Windows is several separate formal controls: cross-device clipboard, continue experiences on this device, phone-PC linking and activity history, each listed and chosen separately; settings sync writes two values at once and is not written in this version.
privacy_original_k39_reason.zh: 现行的三套模板和策略 CSP 都没有 AllowCrossDeviceSync。Windows 的“跨设备同步”是几个分开的正式控制：跨设备剪贴板、在此设备上继续体验、手机与电脑连接、活动历史，本页各自列出，需要分别选择；设置同步（Sync your settings）一次写两个值，本版不写。

privacy_original_k48_reason.en: No AppPrivacy template (24 policies on Server 2022, 26 on Server 2025, 29 on a Windows 11 client, build 26220) and no Privacy page of the Policy CSP has LetAppsAccessBluetooth; the CSP page never mentions Bluetooth. Related but different writable entries: apps control radios, apps use trusted devices, apps talk to unpaired devices; none of them stops apps from talking to paired devices, and no Windows policy does.
privacy_original_k48_reason.zh: AppPrivacy 模板（Server 2022 的 24 条、Server 2025 的 26 条、Windows 11 客户端（build 26220）的 29 条）和策略 CSP 的 Privacy 页都没有 LetAppsAccessBluetooth，CSP 页全文没有 Bluetooth 一词。相近但不相同的已写项：应用控制无线电、应用使用受信任设备、应用与未配对设备通信；三者都不阻止应用与已配对设备通信，没有任何 Windows 策略能做到。

privacy_original_k49_reason.en: No template set and no Privacy page of the Policy CSP has LetAppsAccessDocumentsFolder; this access has neither a Group Policy nor an MDM policy. It is managed per user and per app in Windows Settings (ms-settings:privacy-documents); Microsoft does not document how those switches are stored, so they cannot be written. Ordinary desktop programs downloaded from the web are not bound by that switch.
privacy_original_k49_reason.zh: 三套模板和策略 CSP 的 Privacy 页都没有 LetAppsAccessDocumentsFolder，这类访问没有组策略也没有 MDM 策略。它只能在 Windows 设置里由每个用户逐应用管理（ms-settings:privacy-documents），微软没有公开这些开关的存储方式，所以不能写；从网上下载的普通桌面程序不受这个开关约束。

privacy_original_k50_reason.en: No template set and no Privacy page of the Policy CSP has LetAppsAccessPicturesFolder; this access has neither a Group Policy nor an MDM policy. It is managed per user and per app in Windows Settings (ms-settings:privacy-pictures); Microsoft does not document how those switches are stored, so they cannot be written. Ordinary desktop programs downloaded from the web are not bound by that switch.
privacy_original_k50_reason.zh: 三套模板和策略 CSP 的 Privacy 页都没有 LetAppsAccessPicturesFolder，这类访问没有组策略也没有 MDM 策略。它只能在 Windows 设置里由每个用户逐应用管理（ms-settings:privacy-pictures），微软没有公开这些开关的存储方式，所以不能写；从网上下载的普通桌面程序不受这个开关约束。

privacy_original_k51_reason.en: No template set and no Privacy page of the Policy CSP has LetAppsAccessVideosFolder; this access has neither a Group Policy nor an MDM policy. It is managed per user and per app in Windows Settings (ms-settings:privacy-videos); Microsoft does not document how those switches are stored, so they cannot be written. Ordinary desktop programs downloaded from the web are not bound by that switch.
privacy_original_k51_reason.zh: 三套模板和策略 CSP 的 Privacy 页都没有 LetAppsAccessVideosFolder，这类访问没有组策略也没有 MDM 策略。它只能在 Windows 设置里由每个用户逐应用管理（ms-settings:privacy-videos），微软没有公开这些开关的存储方式，所以不能写；从网上下载的普通桌面程序不受这个开关约束。

privacy_original_k52_reason.en: No template set and no Privacy page of the Policy CSP has LetAppsAccessFileSystem; this access has neither a Group Policy nor an MDM policy. It is managed per user and per app in Windows Settings (ms-settings:privacy-broadfilesystemaccess); Microsoft does not document how those switches are stored, so they cannot be written. Ordinary desktop programs downloaded from the web are not bound by that switch.
privacy_original_k52_reason.zh: 三套模板和策略 CSP 的 Privacy 页都没有 LetAppsAccessFileSystem，这类访问没有组策略也没有 MDM 策略。它只能在 Windows 设置里由每个用户逐应用管理（ms-settings:privacy-broadfilesystemaccess），微软没有公开这些开关的存储方式，所以不能写；从网上下载的普通桌面程序不受这个开关约束。

privacy_effect_uncertain.en: May have no effect on current Windows
privacy_effect_uncertain.zh: 在当前 Windows 上可能没有效果

privacy_effect_no_current_effect.en: The service or feature it governs has ended; writing it changes nothing today
privacy_effect_no_current_effect.zh: 对应的服务或功能已停止，写入不改变当前行为

privacy_fit_honoured.en: Microsoft documents that this edition honours it
privacy_fit_honoured.zh: 微软文档写明这台电脑的版本执行此项

privacy_fit_ignored.en: Microsoft documents that this edition ignores it
privacy_fit_ignored.zh: 微软文档写明这台电脑的版本忽略此项

privacy_fit_not_stated.en: Microsoft's documentation does not say for this edition
privacy_fit_not_stated.zh: 微软文档没有说明这台电脑的版本是否执行

privacy_reason_absent.en: no such setting in current Windows
privacy_reason_absent.zh: 现行 Windows 没有这个设置

privacy_reason_undeterminable.en: where and what to write cannot be determined
privacy_reason_undeterminable.zh: 无法确定写在哪里、写什么

privacy_reason_needs_operation_kind.en: needs a kind of write this version does not have
privacy_reason_needs_operation_kind.zh: 需要本版没有的写入方式

privacy_page_fact_1.en: Privacy is not security: these entries decide what data Windows and apps may collect, upload or read; they do not make the computer more secure, and entries that would weaken security protection are not listed. Many cost convenience, for example location, push or cloud features stop working; each entry states its cost, and you decide entry by entry.
privacy_page_fact_1.zh: 隐私不等于安全：这些条目决定 Windows 和应用能收集、上传或读取哪些数据，不会让电脑更安全；会削弱安全防护的条目没有列入。许多条目会以便利为代价，例如定位、推送或云端功能停止工作，每一项都写明了代价，是否应用由你逐项决定。

privacy_page_fact_2.en: If an organisation's Group Policy or MDM manages the same value, the next policy refresh overwrites what this page wrote; the page always shows the value read back.
privacy_page_fact_2.zh: 策略值写入后，若组织的组策略或 MDM 也管理同一个值，下一次策略刷新会覆盖本页的写入；页面始终显示读回的当前值。

privacy_page_fact_3.en: The edition tables Microsoft publishes for these policies list Pro, Enterprise, Education and IoT Enterprise, never Home. Whether Home applies them is not stated; each entry shows whether this host's edition is listed.
privacy_page_fact_3.zh: 微软为这些策略公布的版本表只列 Pro、Enterprise、Education、IoT Enterprise，没有列出 Home。Home 上是否执行，微软没有说明；页面在每一项旁标出这台电脑的版本是否被列出。

privacy_page_fact_4.en: Policy entries lock the matching switch in Settings so it cannot be changed there; preference entries are the switch itself and can be changed back at any time.
privacy_page_fact_4.zh: 策略类条目会锁定设置中对应的开关，用户不能在设置里改回；偏好类条目就是开关本身，用户随时可以改回。

privacy_page_fact_5.en: Restore writes back the registry value or task state only; it cannot bring back data Windows deleted when the entry was applied (for example Recall snapshots or learned input data).
privacy_page_fact_5.zh: 恢复只写回注册表或任务状态，不能找回应用时被 Windows 删除的数据（例如 Recall 快照、已学习的输入数据）。

privacy_page_fact_6.en: App permission policies bind Windows (packaged) apps only; ordinary desktop programs such as browsers, meeting software and sprawling are not bound by them.
privacy_page_fact_6.zh: 应用权限类策略只约束 Windows 应用（打包应用）；浏览器、会议软件、sprawling 等普通桌面程序不受这些策略约束。

privacy_host_title.en: The machine these entries belong to: the one running this city
privacy_host_title.zh: 这些条目属于运行这座城市的那台机器

privacy_host_edition_unlisted.en: {id}, not an edition the documentation lists

privacy_host_unreadable.en: The Windows version record could not be read, so every entry's edition fit reads as not stated.
privacy_host_unreadable.zh: 读不到 Windows 的版本记录，所以每一项的版本适用都按“未说明”显示。

privacy_host_not_windows.en: These controls exist only on Windows. This city runs on another system, so nothing is read or written.
privacy_host_not_windows.zh: 这些控制只在 Windows 上存在。这座城市运行在别的系统上，所以什么都不读、不写。

privacy_history_withheld.en: This app's earlier changes are not shown: the account running the city is not the one that made them. Nothing can be applied or restored until that account runs the city.
privacy_history_withheld.zh: 不显示本应用以前的改动：运行这座城市的账户不是做出改动的那个账户。在那个账户运行这座城市之前，什么都不能应用或恢复。

privacy_history_unreadable.en: This app's record of its changes could not be read: another operation holds it, or it is damaged. Nothing can be written until it can be read.
privacy_history_unreadable.zh: 读不到本应用的改动记录：另一个操作正占用它，或者它已损坏。读到之前什么都不能写。

privacy_unresolved.en: One change has no confirmed result. Every new write waits until you check that entry.
privacy_unresolved.zh: 有一个改动没有确认的结果。在你核对那一项之前，所有新的写入都会等待。

privacy_reading.en: reading every entry on this machine
privacy_reading.zh: 正在读取这台电脑的每一项

privacy_restore_all.en: restore every change this app made
privacy_restore_all.zh: 恢复本应用做过的全部改动

privacy_restore_all_detail.en: Each entry this app changed, and whose value is still the one it wrote, gets back the value it had before. Entries for the whole machine each ask Windows for administrator approval.
privacy_restore_all_detail.zh: 本应用改过、且值仍是它写入的那些条目，各自写回原来的值。作用于整台机器的条目，每一项都会请 Windows 要求管理员批准。

privacy_not_written_hint.en: Lines from the original list that no entry writes, and why. Where an entry comes close, it is linked.
privacy_not_written_hint.zh: 原始清单里没有任何条目写入的行，以及原因。有相近条目时附上链接。

privacy_open_note.en: Settings on the machine running this city that decide what data Windows and apps may collect. Each entry states its cost and is changed only when you press it.
privacy_open_note.zh: 运行这座城市的机器上的设置，决定 Windows 与应用能收集哪些数据。每一项都写明代价，只有你按下才会改动。

privacy_added.zh: 原始清单之外增加的条目

privacy_written_unknown.en: not known until the target is read

privacy_scope_user.zh: 当前账户；不需要管理员批准

privacy_scope_machine.en: the whole machine; Windows asks for administrator approval
privacy_scope_machine.zh: 整台机器；Windows 会要求管理员批准

privacy_value_task_absent.en: no such task on this machine

privacy_current_access_denied.en: this account may not read it

privacy_reconcile_detail.en: It writes nothing. It records what the target holds now as the end of the change that has no confirmed result, and new writes may go again.
privacy_reconcile_detail.zh: 它不写任何东西。它把目标此刻的值记为那个没有确认结果的改动的结局，之后新的写入可以继续。

privacy_waiting_machine.en: waiting for the host; Windows may be asking for administrator approval
privacy_waiting_machine.zh: 等待主机；Windows 可能正在要求管理员批准

privacy_unsent.en: not sent: the link to the city is down; press again when it is back
privacy_unsent.zh: 没有发出：与城市的连接断了；恢复后再按一次

privacy_result_applied.en: applied, and the value read back matches

privacy_result_restored.en: restored, and the value read back matches

privacy_result_already.en: already held the value written; nothing changed
privacy_result_already.zh: 本来就是写入值；没有改动

privacy_settlement_not_applied.en: the change did not take effect

privacy_settlement_abandoned.en: the target holds a third value; this app no longer owns it
privacy_settlement_abandoned.zh: 目标是第三个值；本应用不再拥有它

proposal_stale.en: This card was made on {was}, and the document is now {now}. It can only be rejected; the run can offer it again on what the document says now.
proposal_stale.zh: 这张卡基于 {was}，文稿现在是 {now}。它只能被拒绝；run 可以在文稿现在的文字上重新提出。

proposal_no_version.en: no version (the file is missing or unreadable)
proposal_no_version.zh: 没有版本（文件缺失或读不了）

proposal_stale_why.en: this card was made on an older version of the document
proposal_stale_why.zh: 这张卡基于文稿的旧版本

proposal_busy_why.en: the decision on this card is on its way
proposal_busy_why.zh: 这张卡的决定已经发出

proposal_pending.en: The link dropped before the city answered. The same decision goes again when the link is back, and the city answers it once.
proposal_pending.zh: 城市回答之前链路断了。链路恢复后同一个决定再发一次，城市只答一次。

proposal_nothing_taken.en: nothing is taken, which is a rejection
proposal_nothing_taken.zh: 一句都没取，这等于拒绝

proposal_amend.en: the inserted sentence, as it will land
proposal_amend.zh: 插入的这一句，落下时的文字

proposal_show_why.en: the editor holds another version of the document
proposal_show_why.zh: 编辑器里是文稿的另一版

gallery_tip_tall.en: This hint is deliberately long. It opens above the control, and where the window has no room above it the engine drops it below instead; a short hint halfway down a page never asks for that, so the fallback goes unseen. Read where this box lands: above the button means there was room, below it means the flip happened, and a box hanging off the top of the window means neither branch took.
gallery_tip_tall.zh: 这条提示故意写得很长。它开在控件上方；窗口上方腾不出位置时，引擎改把它放到下方。页面中段的一条短提示从不提出这个要求，那条回退分支也就无人看见。看这个框落在哪里：在按钮上方说明位置够用，在下方说明翻转发生了，而挂在窗口上缘之外说明两条分支都没有生效。

git_clean.en: nothing has changed since the last checkpoint
git_clean.zh: 上一个检查点之后没有改动

git_since_checkpoint.zh: 上一个检查点之后的改动

git_unavailable.en: this city has no repository to read
git_unavailable.zh: 这座城市没有可读的仓库

mailbox_deciding_none.en: nothing waits for you to decide

mailbox_search.en: search sessions by room or task

mailbox_search_reach.en: Searches every session asked of the rooms this page has seen; a room with no run on this page was not asked.
mailbox_search_reach.zh: 在本页见过的房间问回来的全部会话里找；本页没见过 run 的房间没有问过，不在其中。

mailbox_search_none.zh: 问回来的会话里没有匹配的。

mailbox_earlier.en: {n} earlier sessions are not listed here
mailbox_earlier.zh: 更早的 {n} 段会话不在此处

mailbox_fork_unheld.en: the last run of this session is older than what this page holds
mailbox_fork_unheld.zh: 这段会话的最后一个 run 早于本页持有的范围

mailbox_ask_title.en: a door waits for your own hand
mailbox_ask_title.zh: 一个门在等你亲自动手

mailbox_new.en: something new, nothing waiting for you
mailbox_new.zh: 有新消息，没有等你的事

keys_reserved.en: the browser takes this key before the page sees it
keys_reserved.zh: 此键被浏览器截走，页面收不到

legend_figure.en: a figure at the door is a run still moving
legend_figure.zh: 门口的人影是还在动的 run

legend_flag.en: a flag on the roof is a standing goal
legend_flag.zh: 屋顶的旗子是一条长期目标

legend_lamp.en: a lamp by the door is something stuck
legend_lamp.zh: 门边的灯是有东西卡住了

legend_plinth.en: the plinth is how much of the plan is done
legend_plinth.zh: 基座是计划完成了多少

inbox_count.en: {n} signals waiting for a run here
inbox_count.zh: {n} 条信号在等这里的 run 读

legend_window.en: a lit window is a run

link_send_action.en: send a command to the city

link_send_when_connected.en: wait until the page says it is connected, then do it again
link_send_when_connected.zh: 等页面显示已连接，再做一次

log_window.en: the last lines this page was sent; a log is not history
log_window.zh: 这页收到的最后几行；日志不是历史

machine_core_held.zh: 正常档，按 config.toml 的 [core] priority

machine_core_lowered.en: normal, lowered after keeping a core busy
machine_core_lowered.zh: 正常档，占满一个核之后被降回

machine_core_refused.en: normal, the platform refused the raise
machine_core_refused.zh: 正常档，平台拒绝了升档

machine_enables_bash.en: just, which runs every recipe of this repository in bash
machine_enables_bash.zh: just，这个仓库的每一个配方都在 bash 里跑

machine_enables_bun.en: just build-web and the client's checks, which the artifact gates judge
machine_enables_bun.zh: just build-web 与客户端自己的检查，产物门要看它们的结果

machine_enables_cargo_deny.en: just deny, the supply-chain read just gates ends with; CI runs it on every push
machine_enables_cargo_deny.zh: just deny，just gates 最后那一步供应链检查；CI 每次推送都会跑

machine_enables_cargo_fuzz.en: just fuzz <target>, which needs a nightly toolchain as well
machine_enables_cargo_fuzz.zh: just fuzz <target>，另外还需要一个 nightly 工具链

machine_enables_cargo_mutants.en: just mutants, which asks whether the tests notice a change in a module held to a mutation score
machine_enables_cargo_mutants.zh: just mutants，检验受变异分数约束的模块被改动后测试能否发现

machine_enables_cargo_nextest.en: just test, the test runner every check here calls
machine_enables_cargo_nextest.zh: just test，这里每道检查都调用的测试运行器

machine_enables_chromedriver.en: the browser tool against Chrome, Brave, Chromium or Vivaldi
machine_enables_chromedriver.zh: 对 Chrome、Brave、Chromium 或 Vivaldi 使用浏览器工具

machine_enables_chromium.en: the browser tool through chromedriver or msedgedriver, whose major version must match the browser found here
machine_enables_chromium.zh: 经 chromedriver 或 msedgedriver 使用浏览器工具；驱动的主版本号须与这里找到的浏览器一致

machine_enables_clippy.en: cargo clippy -D warnings, where this workspace's lints take effect
machine_enables_clippy.zh: cargo clippy -D warnings，本工作区的 lint 在这里生效

machine_enables_elan.en: the Lean toolchain manager that just models and just adversary run through
machine_enables_elan.zh: Lean 工具链管理器，just models 与 just adversary 经它运行

machine_enables_ffmpeg.en: an mp4 from the desktop connector's recorder; without it, a frame sequence
machine_enables_ffmpeg.zh: 让桌面连接器的录制器产出 mp4；没有它，只产出逐帧图片

machine_enables_gecko.en: the browser tool, with no driver between the city and the browser; Firefox, Zen, LibreWolf, Waterfox, Floorp and Firefox Developer answer here, and Tor Browser answers too but wants confirming by hand
machine_enables_gecko.zh: 浏览器工具，城市与浏览器之间不隔驱动；Firefox、Zen、LibreWolf、Waterfox、Floorp 与 Firefox Developer 都算，Tor Browser 也算，但要 User 亲手确认

machine_enables_git.en: version control for this repository, and restoring a discarded file from its checkpoint
machine_enables_git.zh: 本仓库的版本控制，也用来从检查点找回丢弃的文件

machine_enables_just.en: just check, the check every change here closes on
machine_enables_just.zh: just check，这里每一处改动都以它收尾

machine_enables_kani.en: just proof, proving a property against real MIR, on Linux only
machine_enables_kani.zh: just proof，对真实的 MIR 证明性质，只在 Linux 上可用

machine_enables_msedgedriver.en: the browser tool against Edge, which every Windows machine already has
machine_enables_msedgedriver.zh: 对 Edge 使用浏览器工具，每台 Windows 机器都自带 Edge

machine_enables_python_wasi.en: the exec tool's python arm, which runs in the sandbox with no socket
machine_enables_python_wasi.zh: exec 工具的 python 一支，在沙箱里运行，没有套接字

machine_enables_rustfmt.en: cargo fmt --check, the first step of just check
machine_enables_rustfmt.zh: cargo fmt --check，just check 的第一步

machine_enables_rustup.en: cargo and the Rust toolchain rust-toolchain.toml pins, fetched on first use
machine_enables_rustup.zh: cargo 与 rust-toolchain.toml 钉住的 Rust 工具链，第一次用到时下载

machine_enables_sandbox_engine.en: the exec tool's program and python arms, fuel-metered and with no socket
machine_enables_sandbox_engine.zh: exec 工具的 program 与 python 两支：按燃料计量，没有套接字

machine_enables_shell.en: the exec tool's shell arm, where a building's CONFIG.toml asks for it
machine_enables_shell.zh: exec 工具的 shell 一支，用于 CONFIG.toml 要求它的楼

machine_enables_webkit.en: the browser tool against Safari, experimentally: BiDi support is partial and safaridriver --enable has to be run once
machine_enables_webkit.zh: 对 Safari 使用浏览器工具，尚属试验：BiDi 支持不全，且须先运行一次 safaridriver --enable

machine_enables_lean.en: just models, the Lean design models, at the version lean-toolchain pins
machine_enables_lean.zh: just models 跑的 Lean 设计模型，版本是 lean-toolchain 钉住的那个

machine_enables_python.en: Python for the probes and data transforms, installed and managed by uv
machine_enables_python.zh: 探针与数据转换用的 Python，由 uv 安装和管理

machine_enables_render_browser.en: cargo xtask render, which measures the built client in a headless Chromium browser
machine_enables_render_browser.zh: cargo xtask render，用无头 Chromium 浏览器量构建好的客户端

machine_enables_rust.en: the compiler, at the version rust-toolchain.toml pins, which rustup fetches on first use
machine_enables_rust.zh: 编译器，版本是 rust-toolchain.toml 钉住的那个，rustup 第一次用到时下载

machine_source_powershell.en: the official elan-init.ps1 script, run by this city without a prompt
machine_source_powershell.zh: elan 官方的 elan-init.ps1 脚本，由城市直接运行，不需要你粘贴

machine_pack_rust_tools_note.en: the cargo subcommands this repository's recipes and workflows call
machine_pack_rust_tools_note.zh: 本仓库的 recipe 与工作流调用的那些 cargo 子命令

machine_pack_install_note.en: one at a time, each compiled from crates.io, each with its own log
machine_pack_install_note.zh: 逐项安装，每一项从 crates.io 编译，各有一份日志

machine_unread_with_toolchain.zh: 随 Rust 工具链发布

machine_unread_many_brands.en: each browser has its own releases

machine_unread_no_source.en: no official release feed to read
machine_unread_no_source.zh: 没有可读的官方发布源

machine_unread_unknown_item.en: this city does not know the item

machine_enables_uv.en: the Python this repository's probes and maintenance scripts run on
machine_enables_uv.zh: 本仓库探针与维护脚本所用的 Python

machine_enables_zig.en: the Zig leaf crates/desktop/ffi builds on Windows, at the version crates/desktop/ffi/zig-version pins
machine_enables_zig.zh: Windows 上编译 crates/desktop/ffi 的 Zig 叶子，版本是 crates/desktop/ffi/zig-version 钉住的那个

machine_install_by_hand.en: the official install script from {site}; this page does not run downloaded scripts, so paste it into a terminal
machine_install_by_hand.zh: {site} 的官方安装脚本；页面不替你运行下载来的脚本，请粘贴到终端里运行

machine_install_admin.en: this needs administrator rights, which this page never asks for, so run it in a terminal
machine_install_admin.zh: 这一条要管理员权限，页面从不申请，请在终端里运行

machine_install_press.en: {source}; this changes the computer, so it runs only when you press install
machine_install_press.zh: {source}；这会改动这台电脑，所以只在你按下「安装」时运行

machine_install_all_note.en: one at a time, in the order below, each after the tools it needs
machine_install_all_note.zh: 按下面的顺序逐项安装，先装后面几项要用到的工具

machine_no_recipe.zh: 这个平台没有安装配方

machine_unasked.zh: 城市还没有检查过机器

mcp_command_help.en: the program and its arguments, as one line

mcp_env_help.en: what the program is started with; a value may be a `secret:realm/name` reference
mcp_env_help.zh: 启动这个程序时带上的变量；值可以写成 `secret:realm/name` 引用

mcp_gap_scope_city.en: the wire writes every server into the building layer
mcp_gap_scope_city.zh: wire 把每台服务器都写进楼这一层

mcp_gap_scope_machine.en: a server kept out of the repository has nowhere to go on the wire
mcp_gap_scope_machine.zh: 不写进仓库的服务器在 wire 上没有去处

mcp_header_help.en: sent with every request; a value may be a `secret:realm/name` reference
mcp_header_help.zh: 每次请求都会带上；值可以写成 `secret:realm/name` 引用

mcp_json_placeholder.en: the mcpServers block from Claude Code or Cursor
mcp_json_placeholder.zh: Claude Code 或 Cursor 的 mcpServers 段

mcp_json_unreadable.en: this is not a readable mcpServers block
mcp_json_unreadable.zh: 这不是一段能读的 mcpServers

mcp_key_first.en: store the key first; the header carries its reference
mcp_key_first.zh: 先把密钥入库，请求头带的是它的引用

mcp_label_help.en: lowercase letters, digits and dashes; it prefixes every tool this server offers
mcp_label_help.zh: 小写字母、数字与连字符；它是这台服务器每个工具的前缀

mcp_none.en: this building reaches no tool server
mcp_none.zh: 这栋楼还没有工具服务器

mcp_servers.zh: 这栋楼能连到的服务器

mcp_shelf_asking.en: asking which applications can be connected
mcp_shelf_asking.zh: 正在查哪些应用可以连接

mcp_shelf_needs_key.en: store a project key above, and the applications it can connect appear here
mcp_shelf_needs_key.zh: 先在上面存入项目密钥，它能连接的应用就会出现在这里

mcp_why_command.en: write the command that starts it

mcp_why_grammar.en: lowercase letters, digits and dashes only
mcp_why_grammar.zh: 只能用小写字母、数字与连字符

mcp_why_pair_name.en: a value needs a name beside it

mcp_why_taken.en: this scope already reaches a server by that name
mcp_why_taken.zh: 这个作用域已经有同名的服务器

mcp_why_url.en: write the url it answers on

palette_transcribe.en: speak, transcribed into the message box

part_error_host.en: that host is not a valid DNS name
part_error_host.zh: 这个主机名不是合法的 DNS 名

part_remove_detail.en: its key stays in the credential store
part_remove_detail.zh: 它的密钥仍留在凭据库里

part_remove_endpoint.zh: 要移除这个 endpoint 吗？

part_unkept.en: This draft lives in this tab only: the browser would not store it, and closing the tab loses it.
part_unkept.zh: 这份草稿只在这个标签页里：浏览器没有存下它，关掉标签页它就没了。

path_reveal_inert.en: this build cannot open a path outside the city
path_reveal_inert.zh: 城市之外的路径打不开

plan_empty.en: no plan yet: the Mayor hands each building its part of the city's plan
plan_empty.zh: 还没有计划：市长会把城市计划中属于这栋楼的部分交给它

plan_node_elsewhere.en: {n} more runs claimed a node with this number in another building, or before this page
plan_node_elsewhere.zh: 另有 {n} 个 run 认领过同号的节点，在别的楼，或早于此页

plan_node_unclaimed.en: no run in this building has claimed this node
plan_node_unclaimed.zh: 这栋楼里还没有 run 认领过这个节点

plan_unplanned.en: no plan to measure against: {steps} steps taken
plan_unplanned.zh: 没有可度量的计划：已走 {steps} 步

provider_cut.en: the answer stopped part-way; the same request is worth sending again
provider_cut.zh: 回答中途断了，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_exchange.en: the request never completed; the same request is worth sending again
provider_exchange.zh: 请求没有完成，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_overflow.en: the conversation no longer fits this model's window (the provider answered {status}); start a new session that keeps the summary, or choose a model with a larger window
provider_overflow.zh: 对话已经放不进这个模型的窗口（供应方回答 {status}）：开一个带摘要的新会话，或换一个窗口更大的模型

provider_quota.en: this account's quota is used up (the provider answered {status}); add credit to it, or add another account to this provider
provider_quota.zh: 这个账号的额度已经用完（供应方回答 {status}）：给它充值，或给这个 Provider 再添一个账号

provider_refused.en: the provider refused with {status}; check this endpoint's model name, key and dialect
provider_refused.zh: 供应方以 {status} 拒绝了请求：检查这个接口的模型名、密钥和接口形态

provider_refused_busy.en: the provider answered {status}: busy or broken for now; the same request is worth sending again
provider_refused_busy.zh: 供应方回答 {status}，表示它此刻忙或出了故障，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_reported.en: the provider reported an error part-way through its answer
provider_reported.zh: 供应方在回答中途报了错

provider_silence.en: the provider went silent mid-answer; the same request is worth sending again
provider_silence.zh: 供应方回答到一半不再出声，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_unbuilt.en: this side could not build the request; check this endpoint's base_url and extra headers
provider_unbuilt.zh: 这一侧没能造出请求：检查这个接口的 base_url 和附加请求头

provider_unreadable.en: the provider answered in a shape the city cannot read; check this endpoint's dialect
provider_unreadable.zh: 供应方的回答城市读不懂：检查这个接口的接口形态

rec_archive_nothing.en: nothing filed matches this search; what a building's runs produce is filed here
rec_archive_nothing.zh: 归档里没有与之相符的东西；楼里各次 run 的产出会归档在这里

event_run_forked.en: a run was branched from another
event_run_forked.zh: 从另一次 run 开出一个分支

event_result_offloaded.en: a long result was set aside
event_result_offloaded.zh: 一段过长的结果被另存

event_steer_received.zh: 你给一次 run 追加了话

event_cancel_received.en: a run was asked to stop
event_cancel_received.zh: 有人要求一次 run 停下

event_watchdog_fired.en: the watchdog stopped a stalled run
event_watchdog_fired.zh: 看门狗叫停了一次停滞的 run

event_budget_limit.zh: 一次 run 花到了预算上限

event_signal_wait_started.en: a run began waiting for a reply
event_signal_wait_started.zh: 一个 run 开始等回信

event_signal_wait_ended.en: a run stopped waiting for a reply
event_signal_wait_ended.zh: 一个 run 不再等回信

event_draft_held.en: a draft was held for review

event_draft_resolved.zh: 被扣下的草稿有了结果

event_roadmap_claimed.zh: 认领了一项路线图条目

event_roadmap_finished.zh: 完成了一项路线图条目

event_roadmap_released.en: a roadmap item was let go
event_roadmap_released.zh: 放下了一项路线图条目

event_approval_requested.zh: 一次 run 请求批准

event_cross_building_transfer.zh: 有东西在两栋楼之间转交

event_backpressure_shed.zh: 负载过高，丢下了一些活

event_credential_lent.en: a credential was lent to a run
event_credential_lent.zh: 把一份凭据借给了一次 run

event_secret_captured.en: a secret was caught and vaulted
event_secret_captured.zh: 截下一份密钥并存入保险库

event_secret_egress_blocked.en: a secret was stopped from leaving
event_secret_egress_blocked.zh: 拦下了一份要外发的密钥

event_discard_restored.zh: 找回了一个丢弃的文件

event_went_back.en: a run went back to an earlier step
event_went_back.zh: 一次 run 退回到先前一步

event_prompt_shape_compared.zh: 比较了两种 prompt 形状

event_roadmap_split.zh: 拆分了一项路线图条目

event_roadmap_blocked.zh: 一项路线图条目被卡住

event_toolkit_link_opened.zh: 打开了一个工具包链接

event_cache_renewed.zh: 续了一次 prompt 缓存

event_harness_reported.en: a harness reported what it was doing
event_harness_reported.zh: harness 汇报了它在做的事

event_remote_session_started.en: a device started a remote session
event_remote_session_started.zh: 一台设备开始了远程会话

event_proposal_offered.en: a run proposed a change to a document
event_proposal_offered.zh: 一次运行对一份文档提出了修改

event_proposal_decided.zh: 一处修改提案已有决定

event_proposal_withdrawn.en: a run withdrew its proposed change
event_proposal_withdrawn.zh: 一次运行收回了它的修改提案

registry_empty.en: nothing has been filed for keeping
registry_empty.zh: 还没有东西被登记留存

registry_note.en: What runs filed for keeping, newest first.
registry_note.zh: run 登记留存的东西，新的在前。

release_ahead.en: newer than the newest available through this install channel ({version}).
release_ahead.zh: 比当前安装渠道提供的最新版本（{version}）更新。

release_behind.en: a newer release is published: {version}, cut {released}.
release_behind.zh: 已经有更新的版本：{version}，{released} 切出。

release_current.en: this is the newest release published. Nothing to do.
release_current.zh: 这就是已发布的最新版本，不用动。

release_mine.zh: 这座城市跑的是 {version}，{released} 切出

release_source.en: this city was built from source, so it is none of the published releases.
release_source.zh: 这座城市是从源码构建的，因此不属于任何一个已发布版本。

remote_about.en: The remote door lets a phone or a second computer reach this city from outside its network. It is opened, and devices are paired and revoked, at the city's own console and nowhere else: no page, device or resident can do it.
remote_about.zh: 远程门让手机或另一台电脑从这座城市的网络之外够到它。开门、配对与撤销设备只在城市自己的控制台上做，别处都做不了：页面、设备与居民都不能。

remote_verb_open.en: opens the door for a while and prints the address a device opens
remote_verb_open.zh: 把门开一段时间，印出设备要打开的地址

remote_verb_pair.en: prints a code a device scans, good once, for ten minutes
remote_verb_pair.zh: 印出一个设备扫的码，只用一次，十分钟内有效

remote_verb_devices.en: lists the devices paired with this city
remote_verb_devices.zh: 列出与这座城市配对过的设备

remote_verb_revoke.en: forgets a device; its sessions end
remote_verb_revoke.zh: 忘掉一台设备，它的会话随之结束

remote_verb_close.en: closes the door; paired devices stay paired
remote_verb_close.zh: 关上门；配对过的设备仍是配对的

remote_route.en: The door needs an https:// route, named in the [remote] table of the city's own CONFIG.toml; docs/operating.md shows the two kinds.
remote_route.zh: 门要一条 https:// 的通路，写在城市自己的 CONFIG.toml 的 [remote] 表里；docs/operating.md 写了两种通路的写法。

remote_not_paired.en: This browser holds no device for this city. On a phone, scan the code /remote pair prints.
remote_not_paired.zh: 这个浏览器里没有这座城市的设备。在手机上扫 /remote pair 印出的码。

remote_invited_about.en: This device makes its own key and proves it to the city. The code in the link is used once; the city never sees this device's private key.
remote_invited_about.zh: 这台设备自己生成密钥，并向城市证明它持有这把钥匙。链接里的码只用一次；城市从不见到这台设备的私钥。

remote_unreadable.en: This link does not read as an invitation. Scan the code on the city's console again.
remote_unreadable.zh: 这个链接读不成一份邀请。在城市的控制台上重新扫码。

remote_lacks_insecure.en: Pairing needs an https:// address, and this page was opened at another kind.
remote_lacks_insecure.zh: 配对要一个 https:// 的地址，而这一页不是从那样的地址打开的。

remote_lacks_crypto.en: This browser cannot hold a device key: its WebCrypto lacks Ed25519 or X25519.
remote_lacks_crypto.zh: 这个浏览器存不了设备密钥：它的 WebCrypto 没有 Ed25519 或 X25519。

remote_lacks_storage.en: This browser keeps no IndexedDB for this page, so a paired key would be lost at once.
remote_lacks_storage.zh: 这个浏览器不给这一页 IndexedDB，配对得到的钥匙会立刻丢掉。

remote_seed_about.en: Shown once and kept nowhere. Reinstalling this page means pairing again.
remote_seed_about.zh: 只显示这一次，哪里都不保存。重装这一页就要重新配对。

remote_persist_refused.en: The browser did not promise to keep this page's storage. It may clear it when space runs short, and then this device pairs again.
remote_persist_refused.zh: 浏览器没有答应保留这一页的存储。空间吃紧时它可能清掉，那时这台设备要重新配对。

remote_locked.en: The door is locked. Paired devices stay paired; the console opens it again.
remote_locked.zh: 门锁上了。配对过的设备仍是配对的；在控制台上可以再开。

remote_forget_detail.en: This browser drops its key. The city still knows the device until /remote revoke at its console.
remote_forget_detail.zh: 这个浏览器丢掉它的钥匙。在城市的控制台上 /remote revoke 之前，城市仍记着这台设备。

remote_unkept.en: This browser could not keep the device, so it is not paired here. Pair again with a fresh code.
remote_unkept.zh: 这个浏览器存不下这台设备，所以这里没有配对成功。换一个新码重新配对。

remote_refused_fingerprint.en: The city that answered is not the one the code names, so the code never left this device. Scan again; if this repeats, the route is changing what it forwards.
remote_refused_fingerprint.zh: 答话的城市不是码里指的那一座，所以码没有离开这台设备。重新扫码；反复出现说明通路在改动它转发的内容。

remote_refused_signature.en: The city's answer is not signed by its key, so the code never left this device. Scan again; if this repeats, the route is changing what it forwards.
remote_refused_signature.zh: 城市的回答不是它的钥匙签的，所以码没有离开这台设备。重新扫码；反复出现说明通路在改动它转发的内容。

remote_refused_length.en: The city speaks another version of the remote door. Reload the page.
remote_refused_length.zh: 城市说的是另一个版本的远程门。重新载入这一页。

remote_refused_agreement.en: The key exchange did not agree. Start again; if it repeats, pair again.
remote_refused_agreement.zh: 密钥交换没有对上。再来一次；反复出现就重新配对。

remote_refused_key.en: This browser's key would not sign. Reload the page and pair again.
remote_refused_key.zh: 这个浏览器的钥匙签不出。重新载入这一页，再配对一次。

remote_closed_denied.en: The door refused: the code was used or has expired, or the door is closed. Run /remote pair at the console again.
remote_closed_denied.zh: 门拒绝了：码已用过或已过期，或者门关着。在控制台上重新 /remote pair。

remote_closed_silent.en: The door ended the connection without saying why.
remote_closed_silent.zh: 门结束了这次连接，没有说原因。

remote_unreachable.en: Nothing answers here. Is the door open, and is this the address the console printed?
remote_unreachable.zh: 这里没有回答。门开着吗？这是控制台印出的那个地址吗？

run_no_prompt.en: this run has no prompt on record
run_no_prompt.zh: 这次 run 没有留下提示

run_prompt_gone.en: the store no longer holds these bytes
run_prompt_gone.zh: 仓库里已经没有这段的字节了

sandbox_arm_help.en: A named boundary must be available. Platform default keeps this machine’s existing choice.
sandbox_arm_help.zh: 指定的边界必须可用；选择平台默认时沿用宿主平台的既有机制。

sandbox_container_help.en: Uses Docker or Podman with a prepared local immutable image. Runtime never pulls images. Each start checks network, user, mounts and resource limits; unavailable or refused boundaries fail closed.
sandbox_container_help.zh: 使用 Docker 或 Podman 与已准备的本地固定镜像。运行时不拉取镜像。每次启动前检查网络、用户、挂载与资源限额；无法提供所选边界时拒绝执行。

sandbox_container_needed.en: Enter the full local image ID and every nonzero limit.
sandbox_container_needed.zh: 请填写完整本地镜像 ID 和全部非零限额。

sandbox_env_help.en: One variable name per line that a child process may inherit, on top of the four every run gets.
sandbox_env_help.zh: 每行一个变量名，子进程可以继承，在每个 run 都有的四个之外。

sandbox_fuel_help.en: Instruction budget for one sandboxed call.
sandbox_fuel_help.zh: 一次沙箱调用的指令预算。

sandbox_fuel_needed.en: fuel is a whole number above zero
sandbox_fuel_needed.zh: 燃料须是大于零的整数

sandbox_inherited.en: This building has no sandbox of its own, so the city's holds. Saving writes one, whole.
sandbox_inherited.zh: 这栋楼没有自己的沙箱，由城市那一层管。保存会写下完整的一份。

sandbox_mounts_help.en: One city address per line, readable on top of the building. Where a run may write is decided elsewhere.
sandbox_mounts_help.zh: 每行一个城市内的地址，在这栋楼之外额外可读。run 能写哪里另有规定。

sandbox_shell_help.en: Whether a run may be offered a shell line at all. A shell line is the one call whose reach cannot be read off its arguments.
sandbox_shell_help.zh: 是否给 run 提供 shell 命令。shell 是唯一一种无法从参数读出它能碰到什么的调用。

sandbox_trusted_help.en: One MCP server label per line that may reach what no checkpoint puts back, such as the desktop of the computer the city runs on.
sandbox_trusted_help.zh: 每行一个 MCP 服务器标签，允许它碰到检查点放不回去的东西，例如运行这座城市的电脑的桌面。

sandbox_unknown.en: the city has not answered yet

sandbox_what.en: What a run in this building may touch. The card is written whole: every face below is what the building's sandbox will say.
sandbox_what.zh: 这栋楼里的 run 能碰到什么。整张卡一起写入：下面每一项都是这栋楼的沙箱将要说的。

setup_account_id_shape.zh: 只能用小写字母和数字

setup_account_id_taken.en: this id is already listed; edit that account instead
setup_account_id_taken.zh: 这个 id 已在列表里，请改为编辑那个账号

setup_account_key_environment.en: key from an environment variable, read-only
setup_account_key_environment.zh: 密钥来自环境变量，只读

setup_account_key_environment_help.en: this key is read from an environment variable; change it there
setup_account_key_environment_help.zh: 这个密钥从环境变量读取，请在那里修改

setup_account_key_environment_unusable.zh: 环境变量已设，但密钥不可用

setup_account_key_kept.en: leave blank to keep the stored key
setup_account_key_kept.zh: 留空即保留已存的密钥

setup_account_key_route.en: The key goes straight to the vault; this page keeps only the reference the city answers with.
setup_account_key_route.zh: 密钥直接存进密钥库，本页只保留城市返回的引用。

setup_account_not_sent.en: not sent: the link to the city is down; the draft is kept
setup_account_not_sent.zh: 没有发出：与城市的连接断了，草稿保留

setup_account_only.en: a provider keeps at least one account
setup_account_only.zh: 供应方至少要留一个账号

setup_accounts_legacy.en: This provider still uses the one key it was attached with. Saving an account replaces that key with this list, so enter the same key again as the first account.
setup_accounts_legacy.zh: 这个供应方还在用接入时填的那一个密钥。保存账号后，这个列表会取代它，所以请把同一个密钥再填一次，作为第一个账号。

setup_accounts_order.en: A new session takes the first usable account in this list and stays on it while it answers; the order decides only new sessions and where a request goes after an account fails.
setup_accounts_order.zh: 新会话取列表里第一个可用的账号，只要它还在回答就一直用它；顺序只决定新会话用哪个，以及一个账号出错后换到哪个。

setup_accounts_order_search.en: Each search starts from the first usable account in this list; the order decides which account is asked first and where a search goes after an account fails.
setup_accounts_order_search.zh: 每次搜索都从列表里第一个可用的账号开始；顺序决定先问哪个账号，以及一个账号出错后换到哪个。

setup_account_forget_offer.en: the key of {id} is still in the vault
setup_account_forget_offer.zh: {id} 的 Key 还在 vault 里

setup_account_forget_sent.en: deleting the key; the city refuses while something else still names it
setup_account_forget_sent.zh: 正在删除 Key；还有别处在用它时城市会拒绝

setup_account_retries_fallback.en: nothing chosen: the city retries an account {n} before it moves to the next
setup_account_retries_fallback.zh: 未选择：城市在一个账号上重试 {n} 后再换下一个

search_card_note.en: which outside service the web_search tool of every run sends its queries to; written to the city's CONFIG.toml
search_card_note.zh: 每个 run 的 web_search 工具把查询发给哪一家外部服务；写进城市的 CONFIG.toml

search_default_at.en: Exa, free and needs no key: {url}

search_no_fallback.en: when the selected service fails, the query is not sent to Exa or to another service instead
search_no_fallback.zh: 选中的服务失败时，查询不会改发给 Exa 或另一家

search_confidential.en: a confidential building is never offered web search, so nothing a run there reads is sent to an outside service as a query
search_confidential.zh: confidential 楼不提供网络搜索，那里的 run 读到的内容不会作为查询发给外部服务

search_override.en: the hall's own files state a different [search] ({choice}, from the {layer} layer); this card edits the city's file and does not change that
search_override.zh: hall 自己的文件另有 [search]（{choice}，来自 {layer} 一层）；本卡只改城市的文件，不改它

search_in_use.en: this is the service in use

search_only.en: the only service; choose default or off to stop using it
search_only.zh: 只剩这一家；要停用请选默认或关闭

search_remove_in_use.en: in use; choose another service first

search_required.en: the address, the remote tool name and the query parameter are required
search_required.zh: 地址、远端工具名与 query 参数名必填

search_id_taken.en: another service has this id; edit that one instead
search_id_taken.zh: 已有一家用这个 id；改为编辑那一家

setup_base_url_normalised.en: normalised from {entered}; the city calls the URL above
setup_base_url_normalised.zh: 已从 {entered} 归一；城市调用的是上面那个地址

setup_display_name_help.en: shown instead of the id; leave blank to use the id
setup_display_name_help.zh: 界面上显示它而不是标识；留空即用标识

setup_effort_city.en: the city's own [model] effort in CONFIG.toml holds until a dispatch states a level for the session it opens
setup_effort_city.zh: 城市自己的 CONFIG.toml [model] effort 一直生效，直到某次派活为它开的那一场另说一个档位

setup_effort_essay.en: A run freezes its effort when it starts, so a change made now reaches the next run and never the one already going, and each change invalidates the prompt cache the provider built for this conversation. Each model offers its own levels and the picker lists only those; none, which turns thinking off, is never among them. Choosing nothing does not leave the decision to the provider: an unstated effort means high where the model offers it, otherwise the level the provider states as its default.
setup_effort_essay.zh: 一次 run 在起点冻结它的强度，此刻的改动因此只到下一次 run，永远到不了正在跑的那一次；每改一次，供应方为这段对话建好的 prompt 缓存都会作废。每个模型提供的档位各不相同，选择器只列出它提供的那几档；关掉思考的 none 不在其中。不选也不等于把决定权留给供应方：没写档位时，模型提供 high 就用 high，否则用供应方声明的默认档。

setup_group_hint_tools.en: the programs this city must find
setup_group_hint_tools.zh: 这座城市必须找到的程序

setup_group_hint_skills.en: what the residents have been taught

setup_group_hint_run.en: what a run may do on this machine
setup_group_hint_run.zh: 一次运行被允许做什么

setup_group_hint_network.en: what leaves this machine, and through what

setup_group_hint_remote.en: Pairing a phone or a second computer with this city through the remote door.
setup_group_hint_remote.zh: 经远程门，让手机或另一台电脑与这座城市配对。

setup_group_hint_keys.en: the keyboard, and what each key does
setup_group_hint_keys.zh: 键盘，以及每个键做什么

setup_group_hint_appearance.en: how this page looks to you

setup_group_hint_advanced.en: the welcome walk, from its first step

setup_group_hint_privacy.en: Windows settings on the machine running this city that decide what data Windows and apps may collect, upload or read. Nothing is preselected; an entry changes only when you press it, and the value it wrote can be put back; what an entry says Windows deletes on apply does not come back.
setup_group_hint_privacy.zh: 运行这座城市的机器上、决定 Windows 与应用能收集、上传或读取哪些数据的设置。没有任何预选；只有你按下某一项才会改动，它写入的值可以恢复；条目注明 Windows 在应用时删除的数据不会回来。

setup_group_hint_accounts.en: who the city may call, and with which key
setup_group_hint_accounts.zh: 城市能调用谁，用哪把钥匙

setup_group_hint_harnesses.en: a subscription reaches the city through its vendor's own harness, signed in there
setup_group_hint_harnesses.zh: 订阅经厂商自己的 harness 进入城市，在那里登录

setup_group_hint_you.en: what the city calls you and the Mayor; a change takes effect in the next session
setup_group_hint_you.zh: 城市怎么称呼你与市长；改动在下一个会话生效

setup_group_hint_rules.en: what a building's runs are allowed, in its RULES.toml
setup_group_hint_rules.zh: 一栋楼里的 run 被允许做什么，写在它的 RULES.toml

setup_group_hint_automation.en: what the city starts by itself, from SCHEDULE.toml and WATCH.toml
setup_group_hint_automation.zh: 城市自己开始的事，来自 SCHEDULE.toml 与 WATCH.toml

settings_next_run.en: takes effect for the runs that start after this
settings_next_run.zh: 此后开始的 run 生效

saving_refused.en: not saved: the city refused it

saving_unverified.en: sent, but no receipt came back; check before saving again
saving_unverified.zh: 已发出但没等到回执，待核对

you_person_note.en: what the city calls you, and what you want its agents to know about you; kept in PREFERENCES.md
you_person_note.zh: 城市怎么称呼你，以及你希望 Agent 知道的背景；存在 PREFERENCES.md

you_mayor_note.en: the name the Mayor goes by; kept in MAYOR.md
you_mayor_note.zh: 市长对外的名字；存在 MAYOR.md

you_mayor_address.en: its address stays hall/mayor: a name changes what it is called, not what it may do
you_mayor_address.zh: 它的地址仍是 hall/mayor：名字只改称呼，不改职责

you_next_session.en: takes effect in new sessions; a session already going keeps the name it started with
you_next_session.zh: 新会话生效；已经开始的会话沿用开始时的名字

you_unreadable.en: the identity area does not read

you_unreadable_open.en: fix it in the documents that govern the city
you_unreadable_open.zh: 到治理城市的文档里改正

you_import_note.en: runs gh on the machine the city runs on, not on this browser's; only the login is read, and nothing is kept until you save the card
you_import_note.zh: 在运行城市的那台机器上执行 gh，不是这个浏览器所在的机器；只读登录名，保存这张卡之前什么都不写

you_import_no_cli.en: gh is not installed on the city's machine; type your ID instead
you_import_no_cli.zh: 城市的机器上没有装 gh；请直接输入你的 ID

you_import_signed_out.en: gh is not signed in to {host} on the city's machine; sign in there, or type your ID
you_import_signed_out.zh: 城市的机器上 gh 没有登录 {host}；到那里登录，或直接输入 ID

you_import_not_a_host.en: {host} is not a host gh knows
you_import_not_a_host.zh: gh 不认识 {host} 这台主机

you_import_failed.en: gh failed (exit {exit}); type your ID instead
you_import_failed.zh: gh 运行失败（退出码 {exit}）；请直接输入 ID

rules_building.en: the building whose rules are shown

rules_note.en: the whole file, written at once; the city reads it before it lands and refuses one it cannot read
rules_note.zh: 整份文件一次写入；城市先读过再落盘，读不懂的会被拒绝

automation_by_hand.en: SCHEDULE.toml and WATCH.toml are edited by hand at the city's root; this page only reads them
automation_by_hand.zh: SCHEDULE.toml 与 WATCH.toml 在城市的根目录手改；这一页只读

admission_title.zh: 什么约束一个 run 的产出

admission_note.en: three values, chosen apart for each dispatch, that combine
admission_note.zh: 三个值，每次派活分别选，可以组合

admission_write_says.en: what the run may change: full writes as usual; create may only add new files and never overwrite one
admission_write_says.zh: run 能改什么：full 照常写；create 只能新建文件，不能覆盖任何已有文件

admission_require_says.en: the evidence the work must carry before a merge lets it in; choosing one does not provide it, and the building's own checks still run
admission_require_says.zh: 合入前产出必须带的证据；选了要求不等于有了证据，楼自己的校验照跑

admission_landing_says.en: whether the work lands: ordinary takes the usual road, experiment stays in its worktree and never lands
admission_landing_says.zh: 产出是否落地：ordinary 走常规路，experiment 留在它的工作树里，永不落地

admission_apart.en: the write limit says what may change; the landing policy says whether the change enters the project
admission_apart.zh: 写入限制回答能改什么，落地策略回答改动是否进入项目

setup_id_help.en: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; the key reference derives from it
setup_id_help.zh: 小写字母、数字与连字符；密钥引用由它派生

setup_key_stored.en: a key is already stored under this name; leave blank to keep it
setup_key_stored.zh: 此名下已有密钥，留空则沿用

setup_key_vault_note.en: clearing forgets the reference here; the vault keeps the key until it is written over
setup_key_vault_note.zh: 清除只让这一页忘掉引用；密钥库里的密钥要被覆盖才会改变

setup_manual_ids.en: model ids this endpoint does not list
setup_manual_ids.zh: 端点没有列出的模型 id

setup_model_needed.en: An empty ceiling is safe to leave empty. Where the provider's model list states one, the city uses it. Otherwise, on the OpenAI-compatible formats the request carries no ceiling and the provider applies its own default for that model, usually the largest it allows; on the Anthropic-compatible format, which needs a number, the city takes the vendor's documented figure, then its policy default. Type a number here only to set your own.
setup_model_needed.zh: 上限可以留空。供应方的模型列表写了上限，城市就用它；没写时，OpenAI 兼容格式的请求不带上限，由供应方按这个模型取它自己的缺省，通常就是它允许的最大值；Anthropic 兼容格式必须带一个数，城市先取厂商文档写的上限，再落到策略缺省。只有想自己定时才在这里填数。

setup_network_default.en: the rule a new endpoint starts with

setup_network_new_only.en: An endpoint attached from now on starts with this rule. One already attached keeps the rule it was attached with, and changing that means attaching it again.
setup_network_new_only.zh: 从现在起加入的端点以这一档开始。已经加入的端点保持它当初那一档，要改就得重新加一次。

setup_next_config.en: one field above is not a shape the city accepts
setup_next_config.zh: 上面某个字段的写法这座城市不接受

setup_next_credential.en: no key is stored under this id: type one, then look again
setup_next_credential.zh: 这个标识下没有密钥：填一把，然后再看一次

setup_next_dialect.en: this endpoint does not speak the wire_api chosen above
setup_next_dialect.zh: 这个端点不说上面选的接口形态

setup_next_other.en: nothing on this form can act on this; copy the details
setup_next_other.zh: 这张表单对此无从下手；复制细节

setup_next_provider.en: check base_url and the key, then list models again
setup_next_provider.zh: 核对 base_url 与密钥，然后再取一次模型列表

setup_next_timeout.en: nothing came back in time: check the proxy, then base_url
setup_next_timeout.zh: 等待期间没有任何回应：先查代理，再查 base_url

setup_probe_busy.zh: 正在问 {host} 提供哪些模型…

setup_proxying_help.en: Which of this endpoint's calls go through the proxy this machine is configured with.
setup_proxying_help.zh: 这个端点的哪些调用走这台电脑配置的代理。

setup_proxying_note_always.en: Every call follows the proxy, including one to an address on this machine. Choose this when a relay on this machine has to see every request.
setup_proxying_note_always.zh: 每一次调用都按代理走，包括打到这台电脑自己的地址。当这台电脑上的中继必须看到每一个请求时选它。

setup_proxying_note_except_local.en: An address on this machine is reached directly; everything else follows the proxy variables and the system setting. If you have not thought about proxies, this is the setting you want.
setup_proxying_note_except_local.zh: 打到这台电脑自己的地址直连，其余按代理变量与系统设置走。没有专门考虑过代理的话，要的就是这一档。

setup_proxying_note_never.en: No call follows a proxy, whatever this machine is configured with. Choose this when a virtual network adapter already carries every packet.
setup_proxying_note_never.zh: 无论这台电脑怎么配置，任何调用都不走代理。当虚拟网卡已经在承载全部流量时选它。

setup_reach_key.en: the provider refused the key: check it, then look again
setup_reach_key.zh: 供应方拒绝了这把密钥：核对之后再看一次

setup_reach_name.en: this host name cannot go into a TLS handshake: an underscore, or a character that is not ASCII
setup_reach_name.zh: 这个主机名进不了 TLS 握手：有下划线，或者有非 ASCII 字符

setup_reach_ok.en: the provider answered; what it serves is below
setup_reach_ok.zh: 供应方答了；它供应什么在下面

setup_reach_path.en: the provider answered 404: base_url carries a path it should not
setup_reach_path.zh: 对方答了 404：base_url 末尾带了一段不该有的路径

setup_reach_refused.en: the port refused the connection: check the port, and whether the server is running
setup_reach_refused.zh: 端口拒绝了连接：核对端口，以及那个服务是否在跑

setup_reach_resolver.en: the resolver itself failed: this machine cannot look names up right now
setup_reach_resolver.zh: 解析器自己失败了：机器现在查不了主机名

setup_reach_silent.en: nothing answered in time: a firewall or a proxy that is not running
setup_reach_silent.zh: 等待期间没有任何应答：多半是防火墙，或者一个没跑起来的代理

setup_reach_socket.en: the connection could not be opened; the detail beside this line says why
setup_reach_socket.zh: 连接开不起来；这一行旁边的细节说了原因

setup_reach_status.en: the provider answered with a status this form cannot act on; copy the details
setup_reach_status.zh: 供应方答了一个这张表单处置不了的状态；复制细节

setup_reach_tls.en: the handshake failed: this machine does not trust the certificate
setup_reach_tls.zh: 握手失败：机器不信任那张证书

setup_reach_unknown_host.en: this name does not resolve: check the spelling, or the proxy
setup_reach_unknown_host.zh: 这个主机名解析不出来：核对拼写，或者核对代理

setup_reach_unreachable.en: the request never reached a handshake

setup_governed_note.en: each run reads these when it starts; a run already going keeps what it was given
setup_governed_note.zh: 每次 run 开始时读它们；已经在跑的 run 仍用开始时拿到的内容

governed_preferences.en: how you want the city run

setup_toml_unread.en: the city's CONFIG.toml states nothing yet
setup_toml_unread.zh: 城市的 CONFIG.toml 还什么都没写

setup_transcribe.en: transcribe · hears (needs an ASR model such as whisper; a text model cannot go here)
setup_transcribe.zh: transcribe · 听写（需要 ASR 模型，如 whisper；文本模型不能填这里）

setup_ocr.en: ocr · reads images (needs a model that takes images; a text-only model cannot go here)
setup_ocr.zh: ocr · 读图（需要能收图片的模型；只收文字的模型不能填这里）

setup_wire_api_unsupported.en: this city speaks chat and messages; it cannot call a responses endpoint
setup_wire_api_unsupported.zh: 这座城市会说 chat 与 messages，还不能调用 responses 端点

skills_empty.en: no shelf in this city holds anything: a skill is a folder with a SKILL.md placed on a shelf
skills_empty.zh: 这座城市的书架上还什么都没有：技能是放在书架上、带 SKILL.md 的文件夹

skills_missing.en: admitted but not on any shelf

skills_unopened.en: open a skill above to read it here
skills_unopened.zh: 在上面打开一个技能，就在这里读它

slash_dispatch.en: open a run with these words

slash_effort.en: how hard the model thinks before it answers
slash_effort.zh: 模型作答前想得多用力

slash_fork.en: branch this conversation from a turn you pick, or from the newest run of [addr]; the original stays as it is
slash_fork.zh: 从你选的一轮开分支，带地址时从那个房间最新的 run 开；原对话保持不变

slash_model.zh: 把 main 指向另一个模型

slash_new_fresh.en: start a new session with no handoff
slash_new_fresh.zh: 开新对话，不携带交接摘要

slash_compact.en: stop the run here, then start a new session that carries its handoff
slash_compact.zh: 先停下这里的 run，再开一个带着交接摘要的新对话

slash_tag.en: give the session in view a tag
slash_tag.zh: 给眼前这段对话加一个标签

slash_untag.en: take a tag off the session in view
slash_untag.zh: 去掉眼前这段对话的一个标签

slash_new.en: start a new session at this address
slash_new.zh: 在此地址开一个新对话

slash_raise.en: raise a building from a template

slash_release.en: let a stopped building or city work again
slash_release.zh: 让停下的楼或城市重新开工

slash_steer.en: say this into the run that is going
slash_steer.zh: 把这句话说进正在跑的 run

slash_stop.en: cancel the run that is going
slash_stop.zh: 取消正在跑的这次 run

take_back_detail.en: The file in the working tree becomes what checkpoint {oid} holds, and goes away if that checkpoint has no such file. What {path} says now is in no checkpoint.
take_back_detail.zh: 工作树里的这个文件会变成检查点 {oid} 里的样子；那个检查点里没有这个文件时，它会被移走。{path} 现在的内容不在任何检查点里。

take_back_not_in_tree.en: this path is not a file of the city
take_back_not_in_tree.zh: 这个路径不是城市里的文件

talk_delivery_held.en: not connected - sent when the city is back
talk_delivery_held.zh: 未连接，城市回来后发出

talk_delivery_unknown.en: the connection dropped before the city answered - not sent again
talk_delivery_unknown.zh: 城市回答之前连接断了，不会重发

talk_wear_hint.en: Map of this conversation: each tick is a round, coloured by what it did; the darker line is what you have read; press to go there
talk_wear_hint.zh: 这段对话的地图：每个刻点是一个回合，颜色表示它做了什么；较深的线是你读过的部分；按下去就跳到那里

talk_failed_refused.en: the city did not take this message
talk_failed_refused.zh: 城市没有接下这条消息

talk_failed_model.en: no model is chosen to answer
talk_failed_model.zh: 还没有选回答用的模型

talk_failed_provider.en: the model provider refused the call
talk_failed_provider.zh: 模型供应方拒绝了这次调用

talk_room_note_mayor.en: the Mayor: plans the city and hands out work
talk_room_note_mayor.zh: 市长：给整座城市做计划、派活

talk_room_note_building.en: the building itself: a message opens a new room in it
talk_room_note_building.zh: 这栋楼本身：消息会在楼里开一个新房间

talk_room_note_room.en: a room in {building}: carries on the conversation there
talk_room_note_room.zh: {building} 楼里的一个房间：接着那里的对话说

talk_goal.en: read the city, answer, and plan where planning is needed
talk_goal.zh: 读完这座城市，回答，需要计划的地方写计划

talk_listening_note.en: what the room's newest run was told, segment by segment; the whole text is on its run page
talk_listening_note.zh: 房间里最新的 run 被告知的四段；全文在它的 run 页

talk_opening_mayor.en: plans, work to hand out, and what the city should do next
talk_opening_mayor.zh: 计划、派活，以及这座城市接下来做什么

inspect_split.en: height of the editor, in lines

inspect_raw_head.en: the original is {bytes}; this is its head

inspect_line_beyond.en: line {n} is past the head the city sent of this {bytes} file
inspect_line_beyond.zh: 第 {n} 行在城市发来的开头之外，文件共 {bytes}

inspect_shot_reading.en: reading the picture from the city…
inspect_shot_reading.zh: 正在从城市里读这张图…

inspect_shot_lost.en: The city no longer holds this picture, so it is not drawn.
inspect_shot_lost.zh: 城市不再存有这张图，所以画不出。

inspect_call_gone.en: This call is not in its run's rounds.
inspect_call_gone.zh: 这次 run 的回合里没有这次调用。

talk_said_nothing_capped.zh: 模型没有输出（输出上限 {n}）

talk_unreadable.zh: 第 {at} 条记录读不回来

tree_no_runs.en: no runs yet in this room

wait_deny_keeps.en: deny stops the work and undoes nothing; files a run deleted are kept in the recycle bin.
wait_deny_keeps.zh: 拒绝只停下这件活，不撤销已经发生的事；run 删掉的文件留在回收站里。

welcome_note.en: Five steps. Only the first is required; the others can wait, and the settings bring you back to any of them.
welcome_note.zh: 五步。只有第一步必做；其余可以稍后再做，设置里随时能回到任何一步。

guide_step_provider.en: connect a provider and choose the main model

guide_step_provider_about.en: Pick a provider or a local endpoint, give it the credentials it asks for, then choose the model the main tag answers with. The other roles keep their defaults until you change them.
guide_step_provider_about.zh: 选择 provider 或本地端点，填上它要的凭据，再为 main 选一个对话模型。其他角色保持默认，以后再改。

guide_step_dependencies_about.en: What the machine running the city has and lacks for its work. Installs run there, one item at a time, and a failed one blocks nothing else.
guide_step_dependencies_about.zh: 运行城市的主机为城市里的工作装了什么、缺什么。安装就在那台主机上一项一项进行，某一项失败不拦住别的。

guide_step_texts_about.en: The documents that tell residents who you are and how the Mayor works. Each saves on its own, and a name takes effect in new sessions.
guide_step_texts_about.zh: 告诉居民你是谁、市长怎么工作的几份文档。每份单独保存，称呼在新会话里生效。

guide_step_skills_about.en: Skills sit on shelves: the city library, a building's own shelf, or an outside folder mounted read-only. A skill on a shelf is not yet one a building may use.
guide_step_skills_about.zh: skill 放在书架上：城市的书库、某栋楼自己的书架，或只读挂载的外部目录。上了书架，不等于某栋楼已经允许使用。

guide_step_mcp_about.en: Tool servers a building may reach, added by command, by address or as JSON, and checked before anyone uses them.
guide_step_mcp_about.zh: 楼能够到的工具服务器，按命令、地址或 JSON 加入，用之前先测连接。

guide_start_needs_main.en: the conversation needs a main model first
guide_start_needs_main.zh: 先选定主模型，才能开始对话

whose_not_oid.en: a commit id is 40 characters, each 0-9 or a-f
whose_not_oid.zh: 提交 id 是 40 个字符，每个是 0-9 或 a-f

whose_unknown.zh: 这座城市没有写过提交 {oid}

wire_frame_undecodable.en: this page speaks wire v{ours} and the server sent a frame it cannot read
wire_frame_undecodable.zh: 本页说 wire v{ours}，而服务端送来的这一帧它读不了

wire_join_action.zh: 接入这座城市的控制面

wire_out_of_order.en: the server streamed frames before completing the handshake
wire_out_of_order.zh: 服务端在握手完成之前就开始推帧

wire_read_frame_action.en: read a frame from this city
wire_read_frame_action.zh: 读取这座城市发来的一帧

wire_read_record_action.en: read a record from this city
wire_read_record_action.zh: 读取这座城市写下的一条记录

wire_record_undecodable.en: this page cannot read the {at} field of a record the city wrote
wire_record_undecodable.zh: 本页读不出这座城市写下的记录里的 {at} 字段

wire_reload_for_client.en: reload the page to fetch the client this server was built with
wire_reload_for_client.zh: 刷新页面，取回与这台服务端一同构建的客户端
